domains.name: client
domains.description: Single source of truth for all client entities served by the firm including corporate clients, government agencies, individual clients, and prospective clients. Manages client profiles, organizational hierarchies, contact information, client segments, relationship history, KYC documentation, and client classification for conflict checking and engagement purposes. Supports both B2B and B2C client types across all practice areas.
domains.references: ABA Model Rules - Client Relationships; SRA Code of Conduct; FATF AML Guidelines

products.name: organisation
products.description: Master record for all corporate, government, and institutional client entities served by the firm. Captures the legal entity name, registration number, jurisdiction of incorporation, entity type (corporation, partnership, government agency, NGO), industry sector, SIC/NAICS code, parent organisation reference, ultimate beneficial owner flags, public/private status, listed exchange, regulatory identifiers (LEI, DUNS), AML risk tier, KYC status, and relationship inception date. Serves as the B2B anchor entity for all matter, billing, and conflict-check relationships. Sourced primarily from Elite 3E client/matter management and Intapp Conflicts.

attributes.name: organisation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organisation entity. Primary key for the organisation data product.

attributes.name: parent_organisation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organisation if this entity is part of a corporate group or holding structure. Enables hierarchical relationship tracking for conflict checking and consolidated billing.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_organisation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ultimate parent or holding company at the top of the corporate hierarchy. Used for group-level conflict checking and relationship management.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.segment. Business justification: The organisation table currently has a denormalized client_segment STRING column. Corporate/institutional clients are subject to the firm's client segmentation taxonomy defined in the segment table. T

attributes.name: aml_risk_tier
attributes.description: The risk tier assigned to the organisation based on AML risk assessment. Determines the level of due diligence and monitoring required under AML regulations.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - AML Standards

attributes.name: annual_revenue_range
attributes.description: The approximate annual revenue of the organisation. Used for client segmentation, pricing strategy, and relationship management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: under_1m|1m_10m|10m_50m|50m_100m|100m_500m|500m_1b|1b_plus — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: billing_address_same_as_registered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Address Same as Registered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the billing address is the same as the registered address. If true, billing address fields may be omitted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organisation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: The maximum credit limit approved for the organisation for work in progress (WIP) and outstanding accounts receivable. Used for credit risk management and billing controls.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit DUNS number issued by Dun & Bradstreet for business identification and credit reporting purposes.

attributes.name: employee_count_range
attributes.description: The approximate size of the organisation by employee count. Used for client segmentation and matter scoping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1_10|11_50|51_200|201_500|501_1000|1001_5000|5001_plus — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: The legal structure or type of the organisation. Indicates whether the entity is a corporation, partnership, LLC, government agency, NGO, or other legal form.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The primary industry sector in which the organisation operates. Used for conflict checking, sector-specific regulatory compliance, and business development segmentation.

attributes.name: is_ultimate_beneficial_owner
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organisation is identified as an ultimate beneficial owner in the corporate ownership structure. Critical for AML and KYC compliance.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - AML Standards

attributes.name: jurisdiction_of_incorporation
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or country where the organisation is incorporated or registered. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the KYC verification process was completed and approved. Used to track KYC refresh requirements and compliance deadlines.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - KYC Standards

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Client (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review. KYC reviews must be refreshed periodically based on risk tier and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - KYC Standards

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: The current status of the KYC verification process for the organisation. Indicates whether the client has passed due diligence checks required for engagement.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) - KYC Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organisation record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the organisation as registered with the governing jurisdiction. This is the official name used in all legal documents, contracts, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character Legal Entity Identifier issued by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF). Used for regulatory reporting and entity identification in financial transactions.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The NAICS code that categorizes the organisations primary business activity for North American jurisdictions. Used for regulatory reporting and industry benchmarking.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: The standard payment terms for invoices issued to the organisation, expressed in days (e.g., 30, 60, 90). Used for accounts receivable management and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for official communications with the organisation. Used for engagement letters, billing notifications, and matter correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary telephone number for contacting the organisation. Used for urgent matter communications and client relationship management.

attributes.name: public_private_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organisation is publicly traded, privately held, a government entity, or a non-profit organisation. Affects disclosure requirements and conflict checking rules.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the organisations registered or legal address as filed with the incorporation authority. Used for legal correspondence and service of process.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the organisations registered address, if applicable. Used for suite numbers, building names, or additional address details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: The city or locality of the organisations registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: The country of the organisations registered address. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the organisations registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or region of the organisations registered address. Use standard postal abbreviations where applicable.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The official registration or incorporation number issued by the jurisdiction of incorporation. Examples include Companies House number (UK), EIN (US), or equivalent.

attributes.name: relationship_inception_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organisation first became a client of the firm. Used for relationship tenure analysis and client lifetime value calculations.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: The current status of the client relationship. Indicates whether the organisation is an active client, prospective client, or former client.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed. Sanctions screening must be performed at onboarding and periodically thereafter.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: The result of sanctions list screening against OFAC, UN, EU, and other sanctions lists. Indicates whether the organisation is clear to engage or requires further review.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: The Standard Industrial Classification code that categorizes the organisations primary business activity. Used for regulatory reporting and industry analysis.

attributes.name: stock_exchange
attributes.description: The stock exchange where the organisation is listed, if publicly traded. Examples include NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, or equivalent. Null for private entities.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The tax identification number assigned by the relevant tax authority. Examples include EIN (US), VAT number (EU), or equivalent. Used for billing and tax compliance.

attributes.name: ticker_symbol
attributes.description: The ticker or trading symbol for the organisation if publicly listed. Used for market research and conflict checking against securities matters.

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trading Name or Doing Business As (DBA)
attributes.description: The commercial or trading name under which the organisation operates, if different from the legal name. Also known as DBA (Doing Business As) name.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: The VAT registration number for organisations operating in VAT jurisdictions. Required for invoicing and tax compliance in EU and other VAT regions.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The primary website URL for the organisation. Used for research, business development, and client profile enrichment.

products.name: individual
products.description: Master record for natural-person clients including individual (B2C) clients, sole traders, high-net-worth individuals, and personal-capacity contacts who engage the firm directly. Stores salutation, full legal name, preferred name, date of birth, nationality, country of domicile, tax identification number, PII classification flags, LPP status, politically exposed person (PEP) flag, sanctions screening status, preferred language, and communication preferences. Distinct from the organisation entity; supports B2C practice areas such as employment law, estate planning, and personal injury. Sourced from Elite 3E and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

attributes.name: individual_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual client record. Primary key for natural-person clients including B2C clients, sole traders, high-net-worth individuals, and personal-capacity contacts.

attributes.name: aml_kyc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_kyc_program. Business justification: Individual clients (e.g. HNW individuals, sole traders) have kyc_status, pep_flag, and sanctions_screening fields but no FK to the AML program governing their screening. Legal firms apply AML programs

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client entity in the client master. Links this individual to the broader client domain for conflict checking and engagement purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Individual has data_retention_category, lpp_status, and kyc_status but no FK to the regulatory obligation mandating those requirements. Legal firms must trace which regulation (e.g. GDPR, Money Launde

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.segment. Business justification: The individual table currently has a denormalized client_segment STRING column. Individual clients (natural persons) are also subject to the firm's client segmentation taxonomy defined in the segment

attributes.name: client_since_date
attributes.description: The date when this individual first became a client of the firm. Used for client tenure analysis, relationship lifecycle tracking, and client retention metrics.

attributes.name: client_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the individual client. Values: active (current client with open matters), inactive (no current matters but relationship maintained), prospective (potential client), former (relationship ended), suspended (temporarily restricted).

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The individual's preferred method of communication for non-urgent matters (email, phone, mail, client portal, SMS). Used to optimize client experience and engagement effectiveness.

attributes.name: conflict_check_status
attributes.description: The current status of conflict checking for this individual. Values: cleared (no conflicts identified), conflict_identified (potential conflict detected), waived (conflict waived by client), pending (conflict check in progress). Required before engagement acceptance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7, Intapp Conflicts Management

attributes.name: country_of_domicile
attributes.description: The country where the individual is legally domiciled, represented as a 3-letter ISO country code. Determines applicable jurisdiction for tax, estate planning, and regulatory compliance matters.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this individual client record was first created in the system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: The credit standing of the individual client for billing and payment purposes. Values: approved (standard credit terms), restricted (prepayment or retainer required), hold (no new work until payment received), review_required (credit review pending).

attributes.name: data_retention_category
attributes.description: The data retention classification for this individual's records. Values: standard (default retention period), extended (longer retention for regulatory reasons), litigation_hold (preservation order in effect), permanent (indefinite retention required). Drives records management and information governance policies.
attributes.references: ISO 15489 Records Management, Legal Services Board Retention Guidelines

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The individual's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Required for identity verification, KYC compliance, and age-restricted legal services (e.g., estate planning, employment law).

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when KYC verification was completed for this individual. Used to track KYC refresh cycles and ensure ongoing compliance with client identification requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: The current status of KYC documentation and verification for this individual. Values: complete (all required documents verified), incomplete (missing documents), pending_review (under compliance review), expired (requires refresh), not_started (new client).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.18

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The individual's legal first name as it appears on official identification documents. Required for KYC (Know Your Client) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.18

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The individual's legal last name (surname/family name) as it appears on official identification documents. Required for KYC and AML compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.18

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: The individual's legal middle name or initial as it appears on official identification documents. May be null if not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.18

attributes.name: lpp_status
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether communications with this individual are protected by Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) or attorney-client privilege. True if privilege applies. Critical for eDiscovery, document review, and information governance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6, Legal Services Act 2007 (UK)

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the individual has consented to receive marketing communications from the firm. True if consent given. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance in marketing activities.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: The individual's mobile phone number. Used for SMS notifications, two-factor authentication, and mobile-first client engagement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this individual client record was last modified, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: The individual's nationality represented as a 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Required for cross-border matters, immigration law, and international arbitration.

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The individual's passport number. Used for identity verification in cross-border transactions, immigration matters, and international dispute resolution.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the individual is a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) as defined by FATF guidelines. True if the individual holds or has held a prominent public function. Triggers enhanced due diligence requirements for AML compliance.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.18

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The individual's preferred language for communication, represented as a 2-letter ISO language code (e.g., en, fr, es). Ensures culturally appropriate service delivery and compliance with language access requirements.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the individual prefers to be called in day-to-day interactions, which may differ from their legal name. Used for personalized communication and relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The individual's primary email address for official correspondence and engagement communications. Used for LOE (Letter of Engagement) delivery, billing notifications, and matter updates.

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: The individual's primary contact phone number. Used for urgent matter communications, appointment scheduling, and client relationship management.

attributes.name: residential_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the individual's residential address (street number and name). Required for service of process, correspondence, and KYC compliance.

attributes.name: residential_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the individual's residential address (apartment, suite, or unit number). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: residential_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality of the individual's residential address. Used for jurisdiction determination and venue selection in litigation matters.

attributes.name: residential_country
attributes.description: The country of the individual's residential address, represented as a 3-letter ISO country code. Used for cross-border matters and international client management.

attributes.name: residential_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the individual's residential address. Used for mail delivery, geographic segmentation, and jurisdiction mapping.

attributes.name: residential_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or region of the individual's residential address. Critical for determining applicable state bar jurisdiction and regulatory compliance requirements.

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal title or honorific used when addressing the individual client (e.g., Mr, Ms, Dr, Prof, Hon).

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent sanctions screening was performed for this individual. Used to ensure periodic re-screening compliance per AML policies.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: The current status of sanctions screening for this individual against OFAC, UN, EU, and other sanctions lists. Values: cleared (no match), flagged (potential match requiring review), pending (screening in progress), not_screened (screening not yet performed).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this individual client record originated. Values: elite_3e (Elite 3E practice management), dynamics_365 (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM), intapp_conflicts (Intapp Conflicts system), manual_entry (manually created record). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The individual's tax identification number (e.g., SSN in USA, NI Number in UK). Required for tax advisory, estate planning, and compliance with FATCA and CRS reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10, OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS)

products.name: profile
products.description: Unified client identity record serving as the firm's Single Source of Truth for client master data across all practice areas and systems. Stores the canonical client_number (firm-assigned), client type (corporate, government, individual, prospective), client status (active, inactive, prospect, former, suspended), references to organisation or individual entity, originating partner, responsible relationship partner, primary practice area, client tier (platinum, gold, silver), AFA eligibility flag, preferred billing currency, billing address reference, client segment assignment, and date of first engagement. Acts as the central hub entity linking to KYC records, engagement scope, relationship teams, corporate hierarchies, and all matter/billing/conflict relationships. Every system interaction with a client resolves through this record. Sourced from Elite 3E client master.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the client profile record. Primary key for the client master data entity.

Business justification: Profile is the primary client record with aml_risk_rating, kyc_status, and sanctions fields but no FK to the AML program governing those assessments. Legal firms link client profiles to AML programs f

attributes.name: primary_practice_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the practice area that represents the majority of work performed for this client (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, Intellectual Property (IP), Employment, Tax).

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Profile tracks jurisdiction, kyc_status, and sanctions_screening but has no FK to the regulatory obligation mandating those requirements. Legal firms must trace which regulatory obligation (e.g. Money

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.segment. Business justification: The profile table currently has a denormalized client_segment STRING column. The segment table is the authoritative reference master for client segmentation taxonomy. This FK normalizes the relationsh

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tier. Business justification: Client profiles carry a tier designation governing service levels and pricing. Linking profile to service.tier replaces the denormalized 'client_tier' text field, enabling tier-based service delivery

attributes.name: afa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is eligible for or prefers Alternative Fee Arrangements (AFA) such as fixed fees, capped fees, contingency, or blended rates instead of traditional hourly billing.

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned based on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) assessment. High-risk clients require enhanced due diligence; prohibited indicates clients that cannot be accepted due to sanctions or policy restrictions.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Standard billing cycle frequency for this client. Monthly indicates regular monthly invoicing; quarterly indicates quarterly cycles; matter completion indicates billing at matter close; milestone indicates event-driven billing; on demand indicates ad-hoc billing.

attributes.name: client_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the client entity or individual as registered. For corporate clients, this is the registered business name; for individuals, the full legal name.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules; Know Your Client (KYC) Standards

attributes.name: client_number
attributes.description: Firm-assigned canonical client identifier used across all systems and matters. This is the business key for client identification in Elite 3E and all downstream systems.

attributes.name: client_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the client relationship. Active indicates ongoing engagement; inactive indicates no current matters but relationship maintained; prospect indicates potential client; former indicates closed relationship; suspended indicates temporary hold; conflicted indicates ethical conflict identified.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client Master; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: client_type
attributes.description: Classification of the client entity type. Corporate includes all business entities; government includes federal, state, and local agencies; individual includes natural persons; prospective includes potential clients undergoing conflict checking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client Master; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: conflict_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of ethical conflict checking for this client. Clear indicates no conflicts; conflict identified indicates potential conflict requiring resolution; waived indicates conflict waived by all parties; pending indicates check in progress.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7; Intapp Conflicts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client profile record was first created in the system. Represents the initial data capture event.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit limit approved for this client for Work in Progress (WIP) and outstanding accounts receivable. Used for credit risk management and billing holds.

attributes.name: data_protection_classification
attributes.description: Highest data protection regime applicable to this clients data. General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for EU clients; California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) for California residents; Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) for healthcare; Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) for payment data; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) for public company financial data.
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; HIPAA; PCI DSS; SOX

attributes.name: ebilling_platform
attributes.description: Name of the third-party electronic billing platform used by the client (e.g., Serengeti Tracker, CounselLink, Collaborati, Legal Tracker, Brightflag). Null if client does not use e-billing.

attributes.name: electronic_billing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires electronic billing submission in Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) format or through a third-party e-billing platform (e.g., Serengeti, CounselLink, Collaborati).

attributes.name: first_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the first matter or engagement opened for this client. Represents the start of the client relationship with the firm.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary legal jurisdiction where the client is domiciled or incorporated. Used for conflict checking and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; Intapp Conflicts

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent KYC verification was completed and approved. Used to track KYC refresh requirements per firm policy.

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Client (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review and refresh. Typically annual or biennial depending on client risk profile and firm policy.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of Know Your Client (KYC) due diligence and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification. Verified indicates completed and current KYC; pending indicates in progress; expired indicates refresh required; rejected indicates failed verification; not required indicates exemption.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Standards; AML Compliance Policy

attributes.name: last_matter_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent matter opened or activity recorded for this client. Used to identify dormant client relationships.

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has provided consent to receive marketing communications, newsletters, event invitations, and thought leadership materials from the firm. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; Firm Marketing Policy

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this client profile record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client profile record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute of the client profile is changed.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, relationship history, or other relevant information about the client that does not fit structured fields. May include relationship sensitivities, preferences, or historical context.

attributes.name: outside_counsel_guidelines_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has published Outside Counsel Guidelines that govern billing practices, rate restrictions, staffing requirements, and matter management protocols.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing Configuration; Client Outside Counsel Guidelines

products.name: kyc_record
products.description: Complete KYC/AML due diligence dossier for each client, structured as a header (review assessment) with child document lines. Header captures: KYC review date, reviewer identity, KYC tier (standard, enhanced, simplified), AML risk rating (low, medium, high, prohibited), source of funds verification status, beneficial ownership verification status, sanctions screening result, PEP screening result, next review due date, and KYC expiry date. Child document lines track each supporting document (certificates of incorporation, passports, utility bills, beneficial ownership registers, sanctions clearance certificates) with document type, issuing authority, reference number, issue/expiry dates, verification method (original, certified copy, electronic), verifying officer, DMS storage reference (iManage document_id), and document status (pending, verified, expired, rejected). This product is the SINGLE authoritative owner of all KYC document metadata within the client domain. Each client profile has one active KYC dossier; historical records retained for regulatory audit. Supports FATF, AML, SRA, and GDPR compliance obligations. Sourced from Intapp Conflicts and firm compliance workflows.

attributes.name: expected_transaction_volume
attributes.description: Anticipated volume of legal services or financial transactions the client will conduct with the firm. Used for ongoing monitoring and anomaly detection.

attributes.name: high_risk_jurisdiction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is incorporated in or operates from a jurisdiction identified by FATF or other bodies as high-risk for money laundering or terrorist financing.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active KYC dossier for the client. Only one active dossier per client; historical records retained for audit.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction where the client entity is incorporated or domiciled. Used for risk assessment.

attributes.name: kyc_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC dossier was approved by the compliance officer or designated authority, authorizing client onboarding.

attributes.name: kyc_document_count
attributes.description: Total number of supporting documents attached to this KYC dossier (certificates, passports, utility bills, etc.). Tracked in child document lines.

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC dossier expires and must be refreshed. Typically 1-3 years from approval date depending on risk tier.

attributes.name: kyc_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the KYC dossier, used in compliance reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: kyc_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC review assessment was conducted or last updated. Principal business event timestamp for the dossier.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KYC dossier. Approved allows client onboarding; expired requires refresh; rejected blocks engagement.

attributes.name: kyc_tier
attributes.description: Level of due diligence applied: standard (normal risk), enhanced (high risk or PEP), simplified (low risk). Determines depth of verification required.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the KYC record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the KYC record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for audit and version control.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review. Triggers compliance workflow to refresh documentation and re-assess risk.

attributes.name: pep_screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent PEP screening was performed. Must be refreshed periodically per firm policy.

attributes.name: pep_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of screening to determine if the client or beneficial owners are politically exposed persons (PEPs), requiring enhanced due diligence.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the compliance officer or partner who conducted the KYC review, for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed. Must be refreshed periodically per firm policy.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of screening the client and beneficial owners against international sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU, etc.). Match found requires escalation.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Programs, UN Security Council Sanctions

attributes.name: source_of_funds_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the client's source of funds (e.g., salary, business income, inheritance, investment returns). Business-confidential information.

attributes.name: source_of_funds_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the origin of the client's funds has been verified and documented in accordance with AML requirements.

attributes.name: to_client_profile
attributes.description: FK to client.client_profile.client_profile_id — Each client profile has one active KYC dossier — this is the primary compliance linkage

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the KYC dossier. Incremented with each refresh or material update. Supports regulatory audit trail.

products.name: segment
products.description: Reference master defining the firms client segmentation taxonomy used for relationship management, pricing strategy, rate card selection, and business development targeting. Each segment record captures segment code, segment name (e.g., Global 500, Mid-Market Corporate, Government & Public Sector, High Net Worth Individual, Start-up & Emerging Growth), segment description, applicable practice areas, minimum revenue threshold, preferred AFA types, assigned BD team, segment review cycle, and segment-level discount authority. Segments drive rate card selection in Elite 3E, pipeline segmentation in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, and partner compensation allocation. Maintained by the firms pricing and BD leadership; changes require partnership approval. Typically 8-15 active segments at any time.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the client segment. Primary key.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Segment defines requires_kyc_enhanced and requires_aml_screening thresholds. The regulatory obligation mandating enhanced due diligence for a client tier (e.g. high-risk jurisdiction rules, PEP regula

attributes.name: applicable_practice_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of practice area codes where this segment is applicable (e.g., CORP, LIT, IP, TAX, EMPLOY). Used to filter segment options during matter intake based on practice area. Null or ALL indicates segment applies to all practice areas.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Practice Area Configuration

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the segment definition was approved by partnership or pricing committee. Used for audit trail and effective date validation.
attributes.references: Law Firm Governance Framework - Approval Process

attributes.name: assigned_bd_team
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the BD team responsible for relationship management, pipeline development, and client acquisition for this segment. Used in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM for lead routing and opportunity assignment.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - BD Team Assignment

attributes.name: client_count
attributes.description: Current number of active clients assigned to this segment. Updated periodically during segment review cycles. Used for segment size analysis and resource planning.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Client Segment Analytics

attributes.name: conflict_check_intensity
attributes.description: Level of conflict checking rigor required for clients in this segment. Standard for routine matters, Enhanced for complex corporate transactions, Comprehensive for high-profile litigation or M&A. Drives Intapp Conflicts search scope and review requirements.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System - Conflict Checking Procedures; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: cross_sell_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for cross-selling additional practice area services to clients in this segment. High priority segments receive proactive cross-sell campaigns and dedicated BD resources. Used in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM for opportunity targeting.

attributes.name: discount_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve discounts beyond the standard discount percentage for this segment. Ensures pricing governance and margin protection aligned with segment strategy.
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - Discount Authorization Matrix

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active segments. Used to maintain historical segment assignments for billing and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition became effective and available for client assignment. Used for historical segment analysis and rate card versioning.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across Elite 3E, Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, and analytics platforms.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework - Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment definition was last formally reviewed by pricing and BD leadership. Used to track governance compliance and trigger upcoming review notifications.
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - Segment Governance

attributes.name: minimum_revenue_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue threshold (in firm base currency) required for a client to qualify for this segment. Used during client intake and annual segment review processes. Null for segments without revenue criteria (e.g., pro bono, government).
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - Segment Qualification Criteria

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this segment definition. Calculated based on segment_review_cycle. Used for governance workflow automation and leadership calendar planning.
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - Segment Governance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or historical notes about the segment. Used by pricing and BD teams for segment strategy documentation and institutional knowledge capture.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Segment Configuration

attributes.name: partner_attention_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether clients in this segment require direct partner involvement in all matters. True for strategic segments where partner relationship management is mandatory. Drives matter staffing and partner time allocation.
attributes.references: Law Firm Client Service Model - Partner Engagement Policy

attributes.name: preferred_afa_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred AFA types for this segment (e.g., Fixed Fee, Capped Fee, Success Fee, Blended Rate, Retainer). Guides pricing discussions during engagement setup. Null indicates standard hourly billing preference.
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - AFA Framework

attributes.name: requires_aml_screening
attributes.description: Indicates whether clients in this segment require AML sanctions screening and ongoing monitoring. True for segments with elevated financial crime risk. Integrated with Intapp Conflicts for automated screening workflows.
attributes.references: AML Compliance Framework - Sanctions Screening Policy; Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Guidance

attributes.name: requires_kyc_enhanced
attributes.description: Indicates whether clients in this segment require enhanced KYC due diligence beyond standard intake procedures. True for high-risk segments (e.g., foreign government, high-value transactions). Drives conflict checking and AML screening requirements.
attributes.references: AML Compliance Framework - Risk-Based KYC Procedures; Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Guidance

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which this segment definition, criteria, and client assignments are formally reviewed by pricing and BD leadership. Annual is most common; strategic segments may be reviewed quarterly.
attributes.references: Law Firm Pricing Policy - Segment Governance

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment (e.g., GLOBAL500, MIDMKT, GOVPUB, HNWI, STARTUP). Used as business identifier in Elite 3E rate card selection and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM pipeline segmentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Client Segment Configuration

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the segment characteristics, target client profile, strategic importance, and business rationale for segmentation. Used by BD teams and pricing committees for segment strategy alignment.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Segment Strategy Documentation

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the client segment (e.g., Global 500, Mid-Market Corporate, Government & Public Sector, High Net Worth Individual, Start-up & Emerging Growth). Primary human-readable identifier used across all client-facing and internal reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Client Segment Configuration

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment. Active segments are used for new client classification and rate card assignment. Inactive segments are retained for historical reporting only. Under review indicates pending partnership approval for changes. Deprecated segments are being phased out.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier classification of the segment indicating strategic priority and resource allocation level. Tier 1 represents highest-value segments with dedicated partner attention; Tier 4 represents standard service segments.

attributes.name: sla_response_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Time Hours
attributes.description: Maximum hours for initial response to client inquiries for this segment. Used to set client expectations and measure service delivery performance. Tier 1 segments typically have shorter response times (e.g., 4 hours) than lower tiers.

attributes.name: standard_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Standard discount percentage off standard rates approved for this segment. Applied automatically in Elite 3E rate card selection unless matter-specific override is authorized. Null indicates no standard discount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Rate Card Configuration

attributes.name: target_client_type
attributes.description: Primary client entity type this segment is designed to serve. Corporate for business entities, Government for public sector agencies, Individual for HNWIs and personal clients, Non-Profit for charitable organizations, Mixed for segments serving multiple types.

attributes.name: target_realization_rate
attributes.description: Target realization rate (percentage of standard rates actually billed and collected) for this segment. Used to measure pricing effectiveness and write-off performance. Typically ranges from 85% to 100%.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System - Financial Performance Metrics

attributes.name: target_rpe
attributes.description: Target annual revenue per equity partner for clients in this segment. Used for segment performance measurement and partner compensation allocation. Null for segments without RPE targets.
attributes.references: Law Firm Financial Planning - Partner Compensation Framework

products.name: relationship_team
products.description: Defines the firm-side relationship team assigned to a client, capturing the client relationship partner (CRP), originating partner, supervising partner, relationship manager, business development manager, and supporting fee earners. Stores role type, assignment start date, assignment end date, primary contact flag, and notification preferences. Supports RPE/PPP reporting, client satisfaction tracking, and BD pipeline management in Microsoft Dynamics 365. Enables accountability and escalation routing for client service delivery.

attributes.name: relationship_team_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the relationship team assignment record.

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Relationship team members are assigned to cover specific practice areas for a client. This FK replaces the denormalized 'practice_area_coverage' text field, enabling cross-sell targeting reports, conf

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity for whom this relationship team is assigned.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship team assignment was formally approved by the authorizing partner.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timekeeper's assignment to this relationship team role ended. Null indicates an active assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments regarding this relationship team assignment. May include special instructions, client preferences, or coordination requirements.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this timekeeper was assigned to this relationship team role. May reference practice area expertise, industry knowledge, geographic coverage, client preference, or succession planning.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this timekeeper was assigned to this relationship team role for the client.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this relationship team assignment. Active assignments are operational; Inactive assignments are historical; Suspended assignments are temporarily paused; Pending Approval assignments await partner approval.

attributes.name: billing_authority_level
attributes.description: Defines the level of billing authority this timekeeper has for matters related to this client. Full Authority can approve invoices independently; Approval Required must escalate; View Only can review but not approve; No Access cannot view billing information.

attributes.name: client_contact_frequency
attributes.description: The expected frequency of proactive client contact for this timekeeper in this role. Used in relationship management planning and client engagement tracking.

attributes.name: client_profile_fk
attributes.description: FK to client.client_profile.client_profile_id — Relationship teams are assigned TO a client. Without this FK, you cannot determine which partners and BD managers are responsible for which clients — breaking RPE reporting and escalation routing.

attributes.name: client_satisfaction_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is responsible for monitoring and reporting on client satisfaction metrics for this client. Used in client retention and service quality tracking.

attributes.name: conflict_check_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper has authority to approve conflict check clearances for new matters involving this client. Typically granted to Client Relationship Partners and Supervising Partners.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7 - Conflict of Interest

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this relationship team assignment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_sell_target_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper has active cross-sell or upsell targets for this client relationship. Used in Business Development (BD) pipeline management and opportunity tracking in Microsoft Dynamics 365.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this relationship team assignment becomes operationally effective. May differ from assignment_start_date for planned future assignments.

attributes.name: escalation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority order for escalating client issues to this timekeeper. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in automated escalation routing for client service delivery.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or jurisdiction this timekeeper is responsible for covering within the client relationship. Supports multi-jurisdictional client service coordination.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timekeeper is the primary point of contact for the client within their assigned role. Used for escalation routing and client communication prioritization.

attributes.name: last_client_contact_date
attributes.description: The most recent date this timekeeper had documented contact with the client in this relationship role. Used for relationship health monitoring and engagement gap analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this relationship team assignment record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_contact_date
attributes.description: The next planned date for this timekeeper to contact the client in this relationship role. Supports proactive relationship management and follow-up tracking.

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Defines the level of client-related notifications this timekeeper wishes to receive for this assignment. Supports communication workflow automation in Microsoft Dynamics 365.

attributes.name: origination_credit_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of origination credit allocated to this timekeeper for this client relationship. Used in Revenue Per Equity Partner (RPE) and Profit Per Partner (PPP) calculations. Sum across all team members for a client should equal 100%.
attributes.references: Law Firm Compensation Models - Origination Credit Standards

attributes.name: relationship_role_type
attributes.description: The specific role this timekeeper plays in the client relationship team. Client Relationship Partner (CRP) is the primary relationship owner; Originating Partner brought the client to the firm; Supervising Partner oversees matter execution; Relationship Manager handles day-to-day coordination; Business Development Manager drives pipeline and cross-sell; Supporting Fee Earner provides specialized expertise.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct - Client Relationship Management

attributes.name: responsibility_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of relationship responsibility allocated to this timekeeper for ongoing client management and service delivery. Used in partner performance evaluation and compensation allocation.
attributes.references: Law Firm Compensation Models - Responsibility Credit Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this relationship team assignment record originated. Elite 3E for practice management assignments; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for CRM-driven assignments; Intapp Conflicts for conflict-cleared assignments; Manual Entry for ad-hoc assignments.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this relationship team assignment record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: succession_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is part of a formal succession plan to transition client relationship ownership. Used in partner retirement planning and relationship continuity management.

attributes.name: to_client_profile
attributes.description: FK to client.client_profile.client_profile_id — Relationship teams are assigned per client — critical for CRP accountability and escalation routing

products.name: engagement_scope
products.description: Defines the agreed scope of legal services the firm is authorised to provide to a client, as established at the client level (above individual matters). Captures authorised practice areas, geographic jurisdictions covered, excluded services, panel appointment reference, panel start date, panel expiry date, preferred counsel designation, rate card reference, AFA framework type, and scope approval date. Distinct from matter-level engagement letters (owned by the contract domain); this is the client-level standing authority. Sourced from Elite 3E and contract/CLM systems.

attributes.name: engagement_scope_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the client-level engagement scope record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aml_kyc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_kyc_program. Business justification: Client engagement scope has aml_risk_rating and kyc_documentation_status but no FK to the AML program governing matter intake compliance checks. Legal firms apply AML programs at the engagement scope

attributes.name: compliance_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy. Business justification: Panel appointments and engagement scopes must comply with firm compliance policies (conflicts, AML, data protection). Links engagement terms to governing policies, ensuring client acceptance criteria

attributes.name: delivery_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.delivery_model. Business justification: Client engagement scopes specify the agreed delivery approach (onshore, offshore, hybrid). Linking to delivery_model enforces contractual delivery constraints during matter staffing and legal project

attributes.name: doc_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standard engagement letter template or Letter of Engagement (LOE) template used for matters opened under this scope. Links to the firm's document management system.
attributes.references: iManage Work Document Management, Thomson Reuters Practical Law

attributes.name: legal_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.legal_service. Business justification: Client engagement scope defines which legal services a client is authorized to receive. This FK enforces service eligibility during matter opening and billing setup — a core legal practice management

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.package. Business justification: Panel appointments and retainer arrangements in legal firms are structured as service packages. Linking engagement scope to package supports panel management, scope-of-work enforcement, and renewal tr

attributes.name: pricing_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.pricing_model. Business justification: Engagement scopes define the agreed billing arrangement (AFA, hourly, fixed fee). Linking to pricing_model enforces the contractual pricing framework during invoice generation and budget approval — a

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity for whom this engagement scope is defined. Links to the client master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Engagement scope has gdpr_processing_basis, data_protection_classification, and geographic_jurisdictions_covered but no FK to the regulatory obligation driving those requirements. Legal firms must tra

attributes.name: sla_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.sla_template. Business justification: Engagement scopes govern SLA commitments per client. Linking to sla_template replaces the denormalized 'service_level_agreement_reference' text field, enabling SLA enforcement during matter management

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tier. Business justification: Engagement scopes are tier-specific, governing service levels and pricing applicable to a client. Linking to tier enables tier-based SLA enforcement, billing validation, and partner approval workflows

attributes.name: afa_framework_type
attributes.description: Type of Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) framework agreed for this engagement scope. Fixed_fee indicates a flat fee per matter; capped_fee indicates a maximum fee limit; contingency indicates success-based fees; blended_rate indicates a single rate for all timekeepers; hourly indicates traditional time-based billing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_fee|capped_fee|contingency|blended_rate|success_fee|retainer|hourly — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Fee Arrangement, ABA Alternative Fee Arrangement Guidelines

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk rating assigned to this engagement scope based on client profile, jurisdictions, and service types. Used for compliance monitoring and enhanced due diligence requirements.
attributes.references: FATF AML Guidelines, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16

attributes.name: authorised_practice_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured text describing the practice areas the firm is authorized to provide services in under this scope (e.g., 'Corporate M&A, Employment Law, Intellectual Property'). Defines the substantive legal domains covered.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client/Matter Management, ABA Practice Area Taxonomy

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this engagement scope automatically renews upon expiry unless either party provides termination notice. True indicates auto-renewal; false indicates explicit renewal required.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency for invoicing the client under this engagement scope. Monthly indicates invoices are issued monthly; upon_completion indicates invoicing occurs when matters are closed; milestone_based indicates invoicing tied to project milestones.

attributes.name: conflict_check_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a conflict check is required for each new matter opened under this engagement scope. True indicates conflict checks are mandatory; false indicates standing clearance has been granted.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this engagement scope record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engagement scope record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_protection_classification
attributes.description: Data protection classification level for client data handled under this engagement scope. Special_category indicates GDPR Article 9 special category data (e.g., health, biometric); highly_confidential indicates enhanced security measures required.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9, DPA (Data Protection Act), ISO 27001

attributes.name: electronic_billing_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the client requires electronic billing submission (e.g., LEDES format) for invoices under this engagement scope. True indicates e-billing is mandatory; false indicates paper or PDF invoices are acceptable.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard), Elite 3E Billing

attributes.name: excluded_services
attributes.description: Free-text description of services or practice areas explicitly excluded from this engagement scope. Clarifies boundaries and limitations of the firm's authority (e.g., 'Litigation services excluded', 'No criminal defense work').

attributes.name: gdpr_processing_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Processing Basis
attributes.description: Legal basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing personal data under this engagement scope. Contract indicates processing is necessary for contract performance; legal_obligation indicates processing is required by law; legitimate_interest indicates processing is necessary for legitimate business interests.

attributes.name: geographic_jurisdictions_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic jurisdictions (countries, states, regions) where the firm is authorized to provide services under this scope. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where applicable (e.g., 'USA, GBR, DEU').

attributes.name: kyc_documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of Know Your Client (KYC) documentation and due diligence for this engagement scope. Complete indicates all required KYC documents are on file and current; expired indicates KYC refresh is needed.
attributes.references: FATF AML Guidelines, ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16

attributes.name: ledes_format_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Format Version
attributes.description: Version of the Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) format required for electronic billing submissions under this engagement scope. LEDES98B is the most common format; LEDES2000 includes additional fields.

attributes.name: matter_budget_approval_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the client requires formal budget approval before commencing work on individual matters under this engagement scope. True indicates budgets must be submitted and approved; false indicates no formal budget process.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client/Matter Management, LPM (Legal Project Management) Standards

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this engagement scope record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engagement scope record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: originating_office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office that originated this engagement scope and is responsible for client relationship management. Used for revenue allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: panel_appointment_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier for the panel appointment issued by the client, if this scope is a panel arrangement. Null for non-panel scopes.

attributes.name: panel_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the panel appointment or engagement scope expires. Null for open-ended arrangements. After this date, the firm must seek renewal or new authority.

attributes.name: panel_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the panel appointment or engagement scope becomes effective. Marks the beginning of the firm's authority to provide services under this scope.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is due under this engagement scope. Standard terms are typically 30, 60, or 90 days.

attributes.name: preferred_counsel_designation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the firm has been designated as preferred counsel for the client under this scope. True indicates preferred status; false indicates standard panel or non-preferred status.

attributes.name: rate_card_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the rate card or fee schedule applicable to this engagement scope. Links to the billing rate structure agreed with the client.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Time and Billing, Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before panel_expiry_date that the firm must provide notice of intent to renew or terminate the engagement scope. Used for proactive relationship management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that records and documents related to matters under this engagement scope must be retained after matter closure, per client requirements and regulatory obligations. Typical values range from 6 to 10 years.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15, ISO 15489 Records Management

attributes.name: scope_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the engagement scope was formally approved by the client and the firm's conflicts and risk committees. Represents the date of mutual agreement.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the engagement scope, including any special terms, conditions, or operational notes. Provides context and clarification beyond structured fields.

attributes.name: scope_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title for this engagement scope, summarizing the nature of the standing authority (e.g., 'Corporate Legal Panel 2024', 'Employment Law Retainer').

attributes.name: scope_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for this engagement scope, used in communications and documentation. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by the firm.

attributes.name: scope_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the engagement scope. Active indicates the firm is currently authorized to provide services under this scope; expired indicates the scope has lapsed.

attributes.name: scope_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement scope arrangement. Panel indicates the firm is on a legal panel; retainer indicates ongoing retained services; framework indicates a master services agreement; ad_hoc indicates project-based authority; preferred_counsel indicates designated counsel status.

attributes.name: utbms_task_codes_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Codes Required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the client requires Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) task and activity codes on time entries and invoices under this engagement scope. True indicates UTBMS coding is mandatory.

products.name: outside_counsel_guideline
products.description: Consolidated record of all client service delivery requirements, encompassing both formal outside counsel guidelines (OCGs) and operational service preferences. For OCGs: captures guideline version, effective date, expiry date, billing rate caps, staffing restrictions, budget approval thresholds, e-billing platform mandate, UTBMS task code requirements, diversity reporting obligations, travel and expense policy, and acceptance status. For operational preferences: captures preferred billing format (LEDES, PDF, e-billing portal), invoice delivery method, reporting frequency, matter update preferences, preferred communication channel, language preference, data residency requirements, and sustainability reporting flags. Represents the complete 'how to serve this client' specification that governs matter staffing, billing, and reporting. Sourced from Elite 3E billing preferences, Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, and client-issued OCG documents.

products.name: tribunal
products.description: Master record for every court, tribunal, arbitral body, and ADR forum the firm interacts with. Captures the official name, jurisdiction level (federal, state, appellate, international), court type (district, circuit, chancery, arbitration panel, ICC, LCIA), geographic jurisdiction, ECF/PACER enrollment status, filing system credentials reference, and operational status. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for court identity across the litigation and dispute resolution practice.

products.name: assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between matter and timekeeper. It captures the staffing relationship where timekeepers are assigned to legal matters in specific roles (responsible attorney, supervising partner, billing attorney, associate, paralegal, etc.) with role-specific billing rates, time allocation budgets, and assignment lifecycle tracking. Each record links one matter to one timekeeper with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment, enabling matter staffing management, resource allocation, billing rate overrides, and workload tracking across the firm.. Existence Justification: In legal practice, matters routinely require multiple timekeepers working in different roles (responsible attorney, supervising partner, associates, paralegals, legal assistants), and timekeepers work on multiple matters concurrently. The matter product already contains four separate FK attributes pointing to timekeeper for specific roles (attorney_profile_id, supervising_partner_attorney_profile_id, originating_attorney_attorney_profile_id, billing_attorney_attorney_profile_id), which is a classic anti-pattern indicating that a proper M:N association is needed. The detection reasoning explicitly states this is 'already modeled via matter_team and matter_assignment junction tables,' confirming the business recognizes this as an operational M:N relationship.
