attributes.description: The body of law that governs the interpretation and enforcement of documents created from this template. May differ from jurisdiction in cross-border matters.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template is currently active and available for use. True if active, False if archived or deprecated. Controls template visibility in user-facing systems.

attributes.name: is_client_facing
attributes.description: Indicates whether documents generated from this template are typically shared with or delivered to clients. True if client-facing, False if internal work product. Affects quality assurance and review requirements.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The primary language in which the template is drafted. Critical for multi-jurisdictional firms serving clients across language boundaries.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the template record or content. Tracks template evolution and supports version control integration.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent substantive review of the template content for legal accuracy, regulatory compliance, and alignment with current firm standards. Critical for maintaining template quality and mitigating risk.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Date on which the template was most recently used to create a document. Helps identify obsolete or underutilized templates for archival.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the template. Provides accountability and a contact for questions about recent changes.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review of the template. Triggers workflow notifications to the responsible practice group to ensure templates remain current with legal and regulatory changes.
attributes.references: CPD (Continuing Professional Development) and Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: owner_practice_group
attributes.description: The practice group or department responsible for maintaining, updating, and governing this template. Determines accountability for template quality and currency.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Approximate page count of the template when rendered in standard formatting. Assists with printing, filing, and complexity assessment.

attributes.name: precedent_references
attributes.description: References to related precedent documents, prior transactions, or exemplar work product that informed the development of this template. Supports knowledge reuse and maintains institutional memory.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Notes on specific regulatory requirements, court rules, or compliance frameworks that this template addresses (e.g., GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), FRAND (Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory) terms). Critical for risk management and audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), ABA (American Bar Association) Model Rules

attributes.name: requires_partner_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether documents generated from this template must be reviewed by a partner before finalization or delivery. True if partner review is mandatory, False otherwise. Enforces quality control and risk management protocols.
attributes.references: Quality Assurance and Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years this template and its usage records must be retained per the firm's records retention policy and applicable legal requirements. Drives archival and disposal workflows.
attributes.references: Records Retention Policy - ISO 15489, Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) Standards

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The file path or URI where the template master file is stored in the DMS (iManage Work or NetDocuments). Used for retrieval and version control integration.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords and tags for search, filtering, and categorization within the knowledge management system. Enhances template discoverability.

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the template for cataloging and reference purposes. Used for cross-system identification between iManage Work, NetDocuments, and Thomson Reuters Practical Law.

attributes.name: template_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the template's purpose, intended use cases, key provisions, and any special instructions for customization. Provides guidance to lawyers on when and how to use the template.
attributes.references: Thomson Reuters Practical Law - Template Documentation Standards

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: The business name of the document template as it appears in the knowledge management system and DMS (Document Management System). Human-readable identifier used by legal professionals to locate and select the appropriate template.
attributes.references: Thomson Reuters Practical Law - Template Naming Standards

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the template following the firm's version control standards. Incremented with each substantive revision to track template evolution and ensure users access current forms.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this template has been used to generate a document. Tracks template popularity and value to the practice.

attributes.name: usage_instructions
attributes.description: Step-by-step guidance for completing and customizing the template, including required fields, optional clauses, and common variations. May reference related checklists and practice notes.

attributes.name: word_count
attributes.description: Approximate word count of the template document. Used for scoping, time estimation, and document complexity assessment.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for all revenue cycle operations including timekeeping, WIP management, prebilling, invoice generation, payment processing, accounts receivable, collections, and write-offs. Supports multiple fee arrangements including hourly, contingency, flat fee, AFA, and blended rates. Integrates LEDES and UTBMS standards for electronic billing and task-based management. Covers PPP, PEP, RPE, and ARPU financial KPIs.
domains.references: LEDES Billing Standard; UTBMS; ABA Formal Opinion 08-451; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

Supports standard hourly rates, blended rates, client-negotiated rates, and alternative fee arrangement rate structures. Tracks rate currency, jurisdiction-specific rate tiers, rate approval status, and rate history for audit purposes. Governs the monetary value applied to time entries during WIP calculation.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client for whom this negotiated rate applies. Null when the rate is a standard firm-wide or practice-group rate not tied to a specific client.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Client/Matter Management; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_card_id

attributes.description: Reference code linking this rate to a specific Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) structure such as a fixed fee, capped fee, success fee, or retainer. Populated when rate_type is 'afa' or 'flat_fee'.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules 1.5; ISO 27001

attributes.name: billing_increment_mins
attributes.description: Minimum time increment in minutes used for rounding time entries billed at this rate (e.g., 6 minutes = 0.1 hour, 15 minutes = 0.25 hour). Governs WIP calculation granularity.

attributes.name: blended_rate_pool_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the blended rate pool to which this timekeeper rate contributes. Applicable when rate_type is 'blended'; allows multiple timekeepers at different levels to be billed at a single agreed blended rate.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; LEDES 1998B; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: client_agreed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally agreed to or acknowledged this rate (True) or whether it is a firm-proposed rate pending client acceptance (False). Critical for billing disputes and engagement letter compliance.

attributes.name: client_agreement_date

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this rate ceases to be effective (inclusive). Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiry. Enables rate history tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The billable monetary rate per hour applied to time entries for this timekeeper under this rate record. This is the principal quantitative value of the rate card. Used in WIP (Work in Progress) calculation during time entry posting.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; LEDES 1998B; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal jurisdiction or geographic market to which this rate tier applies (e.g., US-NY, GB-ENG, EU). Supports jurisdiction-specific rate tiers required for multi-office and cross-border billing.
attributes.references: State Bar Associations; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA; IBA

attributes.name: ledes_timekeeper_class

attributes.description: LEDES-standard timekeeper classification code used in electronic billing submissions to corporate clients and insurers (e.g., PT for Partner, AS for Associate, PL for Paralegal). Required for LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML format compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rate record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: office_code

attributes.name: rate_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure or billing basis against which the rate is applied. Most commonly per hour for standard timekeeping, but may be per day, per matter, per month, or fixed for AFA structures.

attributes.name: rate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary ceiling applied to this rate arrangement. Applicable for capped fee or AFA structures where total billing under this rate cannot exceed a defined threshold.

attributes.name: rate_category

attributes.name: rate_code

attributes.name: rate_discount_pct

attributes.name: rate_floor_amount

attributes.name: rate_increase_pct

attributes.name: rate_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this rate. Supports annual rate increase cycles and client rate negotiation planning.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate record. Rates must be approved before being applied to time entries. Superseded rates are replaced by a newer version; expired rates have passed their effective end date.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; Elite 3E; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.references: Elite 3E Billing Module; Aderant Expert; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was first created in the source system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the billing rate and WIP amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters and cross-border transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES 1998B; Elite 3E Multi-Currency

attributes.name: entry_method
attributes.description: Method by which the time entry was captured in the system. Manual entries are typed directly; timer entries are captured via running timer tools; mobile entries are submitted via mobile app; bulk_import entries are loaded from external sources; api entries are submitted programmatically.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Practice Management

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the time entry as generated by the practice management system (e.g., Elite 3E or Aderant Expert). Used in prebilling, invoice line references, and LEDES export.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry as it progresses through the WIP management and billing workflow. Draft entries are in progress; submitted entries await approval; approved entries are ready for invoicing; billed entries have been included on an invoice; written_off entries have been removed from WIP; rejected entries require correction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|billed|written_off|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert Prebilling; UTBMS Standard

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee arrangement governing this time entry. Determines how the entry contributes to billing and revenue recognition. AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) entries may include capped fees, fixed fees, or success fees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hourly|flat_fee|contingency|blended_rate|afa|pro_bono|retainer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E AFA Module; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Actual hours spent performing the work as recorded by the timekeeper, prior to any billing adjustments. Typically recorded in tenths of an hour (0.1 increments) per standard legal billing practice. Serves as the raw input before billable hours are determined.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert; Elite 3E

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is designated as billable to the client (True) or non-billable (False). Non-billable entries may include pro bono work, administrative time, or courtesy write-offs. Drives WIP accumulation and invoice inclusion logic.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: is_contingency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is recorded under a contingency fee arrangement (True), where billing is conditional on case outcome. Contingency entries accumulate WIP but are not invoiced until the contingency event occurs. Supports AFA tracking.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5(c); Elite 3E AFA Module

attributes.name: ledes_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Line Item Number
attributes.description: The line item number assigned to this time entry in the LEDES electronic billing file submitted to the client or client billing system. Required for LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML format compliance and for reconciliation of electronic billing submissions.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B Standard; LEDES Oversight Committee; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: lpp_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the narrative or details of this time entry are subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) or attorney-client privilege protections (True). LPP-protected entries require restricted access controls and must be handled in compliance with privilege preservation obligations during eDiscovery and regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: Legal Professional Privilege (LPP); ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6; GDPR Article 9; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was last modified in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; GDPR Article 5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of the legal work performed, as entered by the timekeeper. Appears on client invoices and prebilling reports. Subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) protections. Must be sufficiently detailed to satisfy ABA Model Rule 1.5 billing transparency requirements and client billing guidelines.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Legal Professional Privilege (LPP); Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: no_charge
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been designated as no-charge (True), meaning the work was performed but will not be billed to the client. Distinct from non-billable entries; no-charge entries may appear on invoices at zero value for transparency.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or practice location associated with this time entry. Used for office-level revenue reporting, profitability analysis, and jurisdictional billing compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; Law Society of England and Wales; State Bar Associations

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the phase or stage of the matter to which this time entry belongs (e.g., pleadings, discovery, trial, closing). Used in Legal Project Management (LPM) for budget tracking against matter phases and milestone-based billing.
attributes.references: UTBMS Phase Codes; Elite 3E Matter Management; Legal Project Management (LPM) Standards

attributes.name: practice_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the practice group or department (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, IP, Employment) to which the timekeeper belongs at the time of entry. Supports practice group profitability reporting and resource allocation analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Management Standards

attributes.name: pro_bono_category
attributes.description: Classification of the pro bono service type when the time entry is designated as pro bono (e.g., access to justice, nonprofit representation, government service). Null for non-pro-bono entries. Supports ABA pro bono reporting requirements and firm CSR metrics.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 6.1 (Pro Bono Publico Service); Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol; Elite 3E

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which this time entry record was sourced into the data lakehouse. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across the billing technology stack.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timekeeper formally submitted the time entry for approval. Marks the transition from draft to submitted status. Used for timekeeping compliance monitoring and late submission reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Management

attributes.name: task_description
attributes.description: Structured description of the specific legal task performed, distinct from the free-text narrative. May be derived from or supplement the UTBMS task code with matter-specific context. Used in task-based matter management and Legal Project Management (LPM) reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; Elite 3E Matter Management; Legal Project Management (LPM) Standards; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardized activity code describing the specific activity performed within the task (e.g., A101 for Plan and Prepare, A102 for Research, A103 for Draft/Revise). Used in conjunction with utbms_task_code for granular task-based billing analysis and LEDES export.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; LEDES 1998B Standard; ABA; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: UTBMS expense code applicable when the time entry is associated with a disbursement or expense component (e.g., E101 for Copying, E106 for Computer Research). Nullable for pure time entries with no expense component.

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardized task code classifying the type of legal work performed (e.g., L110 for Fact Investigation, L120 for Analysis/Strategy, B110 for Retention/Billing). Required for LEDES electronic billing submissions and task-based matter management reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; LEDES 1998B Standard; ABA; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: wip_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of unbilled work represented by this time entry, calculated as billable_hours multiplied by billing_rate. Represents the WIP balance contribution of this entry. Reduced to zero when the entry is billed or written off.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; ABA Model Rules 1.5; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the legal work was actually performed. This is the principal business event date for the time entry, distinct from the date the entry was created or submitted in the system. Critical for WIP aging, billing period cutoffs, and matter chronology.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management System; Aderant Expert; LEDES 1998B; ABA Model Rules 1.5

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount by which the original WIP value of this entry was reduced during prebilling review or billing adjustment. Represents the difference between the originally recorded WIP value and the amount actually billed. Used for realization rate analysis and partner performance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E WIP Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

attributes.name: write_down_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any write-down applied to this time entry (e.g., client discount, billing guideline non-compliance, courtesy reduction, duplicate entry). Required for realization analysis and billing adjustment reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E WIP Management; Aderant Expert; ABA Law Firm Financial Management

products.name: billing_disbursement
products.description: Transactional record of out-of-pocket expenses and costs incurred on behalf of a client matter, including court filing fees, expert witness fees, travel, courier, photocopying, and third-party vendor costs. Captures UTBMS expense codes, disbursement type, amount, tax treatment, billable flag, and recovery status. Supports both hard disbursements (direct client pass-through costs) and soft disbursements (overhead recoveries). Feeds WIP accumulation alongside time entries.

attributes.name: billing_disbursement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each disbursement record in the billing domain. Primary key for the disbursement data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ip.asset. Business justification: IP-specific disbursements (filing fees, annuity payments, prosecution expenses, translation costs) are directly attributable to specific IP assets for cost recovery, portfolio profitability analysis,

attributes.name: docket_deadline_id

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Court-related expenses (filing fees, service costs, transcript fees) are tracked against specific dockets for client billing, cost recovery, and LEDES expense reporting in litigation matters.

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.fee_arrangement. Business justification: Disbursements occur within the context of a fee arrangement, which governs whether expenses are billable, subject to caps, or excluded. Currently disbursement has fee_arrangement_type (string code) bu

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.filing. Business justification: Filing fees are direct costs tied to specific court filings. Firms track disbursements per filing for accurate cost recovery, client transparency, and LEDES compliance.

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client matter against which this disbursement is recorded. Links the disbursement to the matter for Work in Progress (WIP) accumulation and billing purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Disbursements are tracked by practice area for expense policy compliance, reimbursement approval, and profitability analysis. Practice area determines expense policies, markup rules, and cost manageme

attributes.name: production_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.production_set. Business justification: Document productions incur disbursements (printing, media, delivery, processing vendor fees) tracked at the production set level. Firms bill clients for production costs per set. A litigation billing

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client on whose behalf the disbursement was incurred. Used for client-level cost reporting and billing aggregation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: prosecution_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ip.prosecution_event. Business justification: Official fees and filing disbursements are incurred at specific prosecution events (filing responses, paying issue fees). IP cost tracking and client billing require linking each disbursement to the p

attributes.name: trust_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trust.account. Business justification: Billing disbursements (court fees, filing costs) are frequently funded directly from client trust accounts. Regulatory compliance and three-way reconciliation require tracing each trust-funded disburs

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of the disbursement as incurred or paid, before any tax, markup, or write-down adjustments. Represents the base cost for WIP accumulation and billing calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the partner or billing supervisor who approved the disbursement for billing. Required for disbursements above the firm's approval threshold and for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disbursement was approved for billing by the responsible partner or billing supervisor. Used for billing workflow tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA)

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: The disbursement amount converted to the firm's base billing currency using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, Profit Per Partner (PPP) and Revenue Per Equity Partner (RPE) KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: The amount actually billed to the client on the invoice, after applying any markup, write-down, or billing adjustment. May differ from the disbursement amount if a write-down was applied during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: billing_disbursement_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the disbursement as it will appear on the client invoice and in the billing system. Describes the nature of the expense incurred (e.g., 'Court filing fee — Superior Court of California', 'Expert witness fee — Dr. J. Smith'). Supports LEDES line-item narrative requirements.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B; American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: billing_period
attributes.description: The billing period (YYYY-MM) to which the disbursement is allocated for invoicing purposes. Used for period-based WIP reporting, prebilling, and financial close processes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: The internal cost centre code to which the disbursement is attributed for management accounting and profitability reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the disbursement record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, WIP aging, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the disbursement amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency matters and cross-border transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: disbursement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the disbursement record. Used for audit trails, client queries, and cross-system reconciliation with Elite 3E and Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: disbursement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the disbursement record. 'wip' indicates the cost is in Work in Progress (WIP) awaiting billing; 'billed' indicates it has been included on a client invoice; 'written_off' indicates the amount has been written off and will not be recovered.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: disbursement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the disbursement as a hard disbursement (direct out-of-pocket cost paid to a third party on behalf of the client, e.g., court filing fees, expert witness fees) or a soft disbursement (internal overhead recovery, e.g., photocopying, internal printing). Determines pass-through billing treatment.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the disbursement was entered into the practice management system. May differ from the expense date when costs are posted retrospectively. Used for WIP aging calculations from the entry date perspective.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the disbursement amount from the transaction currency to the firm's base billing currency at the time of entry. Used for multi-currency matter billing and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: Internal firm classification of the disbursement type used for cost management and reporting (e.g., court_filing, expert_witness, travel, courier, photocopying, translation, process_server, deposition). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: court_filing|expert_witness|travel|courier|photocopying|translation|process_server|deposition|search_fee|recording_fee — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: expense_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the disbursement was incurred or the expense was paid. This is the principal business event date used for WIP aging, billing period allocation, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the disbursement is posted in the firm's accounting system. Used for financial reporting, cost allocation, and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disbursement is billable to the client (True) or is a non-billable internal cost (False). Non-billable disbursements are absorbed by the firm and excluded from client invoices but included in matter cost reporting.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disbursement is subject to applicable taxes (e.g., VAT, GST) when billed to the client. Drives tax calculation logic in the billing system.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); jurisdiction-specific tax regulations; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: ledes_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Expense Code
attributes.description: The Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) expense code used in electronic billing submissions to corporate clients and insurance companies. Aligns with LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML format requirements.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B; LEDES XML; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage markup applied to the base disbursement amount when billing to the client. Common for soft disbursements such as photocopying or printing where the firm applies a standard recovery rate above cost. Zero for hard disbursements passed through at cost.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: narrative_for_client
attributes.description: The client-facing narrative or description of the disbursement as it appears on the client invoice. May differ from the internal description field. Supports compliance with client billing guidelines and Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) reporting requirements.
attributes.references: LEDES 1998B; American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or location from which the disbursement was incurred. Used for geographic cost allocation, multi-office financial reporting, and jurisdictional tax compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity or unit count associated with the disbursement where applicable (e.g., number of pages photocopied, number of miles travelled, number of documents served). Used with unit_rate to derive the disbursement amount for volume-based expenses.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; UTBMS Code Set

attributes.name: receipt_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the receipt or proof of payment supporting the disbursement. Used for expense substantiation, audit compliance, and client billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current recovery status of the disbursement cost from the client. 'unrecovered' means the cost has not yet been billed or paid; 'partially_recovered' means a portion has been collected; 'fully_recovered' means the full amount has been received; 'written_off' means recovery has been abandoned.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which the disbursement record was sourced (e.g., Elite 3E, Aderant Expert, manual entry, expense portal). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) applicable to the disbursement as billed to the client. Calculated based on the applicable tax code and jurisdiction. Required for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS); jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to the disbursement to determine the applicable tax rate and treatment (e.g., VAT standard rate, zero-rated, exempt). Sourced from the firm's tax configuration in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit rate applied to the quantity to calculate the disbursement amount (e.g., cost per page, cost per mile). Used for volume-based soft disbursements such as photocopying and mileage recovery.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA) Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the disbursement record was last modified in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 5; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: Standardised Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) expense code classifying the nature of the disbursement (e.g., E101 for copying, E106 for computer research, E112 for court fees). Required for LEDES electronic billing submissions to corporate clients.
attributes.references: UTBMS Code Set; LEDES 1998B; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice or reference number from the third-party vendor's invoice supporting the disbursement. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor, supplier, or service provider from whom the disbursement cost was incurred (e.g., court, expert witness firm, courier company, translation agency). Applicable primarily to hard disbursements.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Financial Action Task Force (FATF) AML compliance

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount by which the disbursement was reduced during prebilling review before invoicing. Represents the difference between the recorded amount and the billed amount. Used for realization rate analysis and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the disbursement was written off or written down. Used for profitability analysis, billing quality management, and partner performance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

products.name: wip_ledger

Critical for PPP (Profit Per Partner), PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner), and RPE (Revenue Per Employee) financial KPI calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WIP ledger record was first created in the source practice management system. Provides the authoritative record creation audit timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this WIP entry (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters and cross-border client engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the WIP entry was recorded in the practice management system. May differ from work_date due to late time entry. Used for compliance monitoring of timekeeping policies and WIP aging from entry perspective.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the WIP entry amount from the matter currency to the firm's functional reporting currency at the time of entry. Used for consolidated financial reporting and multi-currency WIP analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ISO 4217; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Number of billable hours recorded for this WIP entry. Applicable when wip_type is 'time'. Expressed in decimal hours (e.g., 1.50 = 1 hour 30 minutes). Null for disbursement and fixed-fee entries.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WIP entry is designated as billable to the client (True) or non-billable/internal (False). Non-billable WIP is tracked for cost management and matter profitability analysis but excluded from client invoices.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: is_contingency_accrual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WIP entry represents an accrued contingency fee amount (True) that is not yet realised pending case outcome. Contingency WIP is tracked separately for financial reporting and is only recognised as revenue upon successful resolution.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WIP ledger record was most recently updated in the source practice management system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Matter phase code identifying the stage of the legal engagement to which this WIP entry belongs (e.g., pleadings, discovery, trial). Used in matter budgeting, phase-based billing, and LPM (Legal Project Management) reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; UTBMS; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this WIP ledger entry was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability in the Silver layer of the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: standard_amount
attributes.description: The WIP value calculated at the timekeeper's standard rack rate (hours_worked multiplied by standard_rate). Used to measure the variance between standard and billed value, supporting write-up/write-down analysis and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The timekeeper's published standard rack rate per hour before any client-specific discounts or negotiated rate agreements are applied. Used to calculate write-up/write-down variance against billing_rate for financial KPI reporting including RPE.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised activity code describing the specific activity performed within a task (e.g., A101 for Plan and Prepare, A102 for Research). Complements the task code for granular task-based billing and client invoice compliance.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: utbms_expense_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Expense Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised expense code for disbursement and expense WIP entries (e.g., E101 for Copying, E106 for Online Research). Populated only when wip_type is 'disbursement' or 'expense'.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: UTBMS standardised task code classifying the legal work performed (e.g., L110 for Fact Investigation, L120 for Analysis/Strategy). Enables task-based billing analysis, client reporting, and benchmarking against industry spend data.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard; Association of Corporate Counsel (ACC)

attributes.name: wip_accumulates_disbursement
attributes.description: FK to billing.disbursement.disbursement_id — WIP ledger entries also accumulate from disbursements. This FK enables complete WIP composition analysis.

attributes.name: wip_age_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work in Progress (WIP) Age in Days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed since the work_date of this WIP entry. Used to populate WIP aging buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) for financial reporting, collections prioritisation, and partner performance reviews.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: wip_amount
attributes.description: The gross WIP value of this entry calculated as hours_worked multiplied by billing_rate for time entries, or the disbursement amount for expense entries. Represents the unbilled revenue value before any write-up or write-down adjustments. Core field for PPP, PEP, and RPE financial KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: wip_amount_firm_currency
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work in Progress (WIP) Amount in Firm Currency
attributes.description: The WIP amount converted to the firm's functional reporting currency using the exchange_rate. Enables consolidated WIP reporting, PPP, PEP, and RPE calculations across matters billed in multiple currencies.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 21; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 302

attributes.name: wip_entry_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this WIP ledger entry as assigned by the practice management system (e.g., Elite 3E transaction number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: wip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the WIP ledger entry. 'open' indicates unbilled WIP available for prebilling; 'billed' indicates the entry has been included on an invoice; 'written_off' indicates the amount has been written off; 'transferred' indicates the WIP has been moved to another matter; 'on_hold' indicates billing is suspended; 'reversed' indicates the entry has been reversed.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: wip_type
attributes.description: Classification of the WIP entry by nature of the charge. 'time' represents billable hours; 'disbursement' represents client-chargeable out-of-pocket costs; 'expense' represents firm expenses; 'fixed_fee' represents flat-fee milestone charges; 'contingency' represents contingency-based accruals.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES 1998B Standard; Elite 3E

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the billable work or disbursement was performed. This is the principal real-world event date for the WIP entry, distinct from the date the entry was recorded in the system. Critical for WIP aging calculations and billing period allocation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: work_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the work performed or disbursement incurred as entered by the timekeeper. Appears on prebill and client invoice. Subject to billing guidelines review and may be edited during the prebilling process.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of WIP that has been written off and will not be billed to the client. Populated when wip_status is 'written_off'. Used in realisation rate calculations and partner performance reviews.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised reason code explaining why the WIP entry was written off (e.g., client dispute, fee cap exceeded, courtesy write-off, uncollectable). Populated when wip_status is 'written_off'. Used in write-off analysis and partner performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: client_dispute|fee_cap_exceeded|courtesy|uncollectable|billing_error|matter_closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: write_up_down_amount
attributes.description: The monetary adjustment applied to the WIP entry representing the difference between the standard amount and the billed amount. Positive values indicate a write-up (billing above standard); negative values indicate a write-down (billing below standard). Critical for realisation rate analysis and partner performance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

products.name: prebill
products.description: Pre-invoice draft generated from WIP for attorney review and approval before final invoice issuance. Captures prebill number, matter reference, billing attorney, billing period, total WIP value, proposed adjustments, write-up/write-down amounts, and prebill status (draft, under review, approved, rejected). Supports the prebilling workflow including partner review, narrative editing, and billing guideline compliance checks. Central to the legal billing quality control process.

attributes.name: prebill_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the prebill record. Primary key for the prebill data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Prebills for litigation matters reference specific dockets for attorney review of court-related charges, billing guideline compliance checking, and client communication before final invoicing.

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee arrangement governing this prebill, such as hourly, flat fee, contingency, or Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA). Determines billing calculation methodology.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the final invoice generated from this approved prebill. Populated once the prebill transitions to approved status and the invoice is created. Null if the prebill has not yet been converted to an invoice.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: legal_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.legal_service. Business justification: Prebills are generated for work performed on a specific legal service. Legal billing teams review prebills by service type for service-level revenue recognition and billing guideline compliance. prebi

attributes.name: letter_of_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.letter_of_engagement. Business justification: Prebill review validates proposed charges against the letter of engagement terms before invoice finalization. Billing attorneys must verify scope compliance, rate adherence, and guideline conformance

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Prebills are reviewed and approved by practice area leadership. Practice area determines approval authority, billing guideline compliance rules, and realization targets used in prebill review workflow

attributes.name: prebill_ledes_matter_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Matter ID
attributes.description: Client-assigned matter identifier formatted per LEDES electronic billing standards. Required for electronic invoice submission to corporate clients and insurance carriers using LEDES-compliant billing systems.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard) 1998B / 2000 / XML specifications; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: prebill_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the matter against which this prebill is generated. Links the prebill to the specific legal matter or case being billed.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity responsible for payment of this prebill. Derived from the matter-client relationship for billing purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: wip_ledger_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.wip_ledger.wip_ledger_id — Prebills are generated from WIP balances. This link enables the prebilling workflow to pull unbilled WIP for attorney review and ensures WIP-to-invoice traceability.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing attorney formally approved the prebill for invoice generation. Marks the transition to approved status and triggers the invoice creation workflow.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which invoices are issued for this matter, as agreed in the engagement letter. Drives prebill generation scheduling: monthly, quarterly, at defined milestones, on-demand, or annually.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Letter of Engagement (LOE) standards; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: billing_guideline_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prebill has passed automated billing guideline compliance checks against the applicable client billing guidelines. True = compliant; False = one or more violations detected requiring attorney review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; client-specific billing guideline agreements

attributes.name: billing_guideline_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the client billing guidelines applied during prebill review and compliance checking. Corporate clients and insurers issue versioned billing guidelines that restrict rates, timekeepers, task codes, and narrative formats.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; client-specific billing guideline agreements

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the billing period covered by this prebill. Defines the inclusive end of the Work in Progress (WIP) window extracted for review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the billing period covered by this prebill. Defines the inclusive start of the Work in Progress (WIP) window extracted for review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the prebill record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this prebill (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international matters.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); International Bar Association (IBA)

attributes.name: disbursement_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustment applied to disbursements on this prebill. Positive values indicate write-up; negative values indicate write-down or non-billable disbursement exclusions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing fee structure applied to this prebill. Determines how WIP is calculated and presented: hourly (time-based), flat_fee (fixed amount), contingency (outcome-based percentage), afa (Alternative Fee Arrangement), blended_rate (composite rate across timekeepers), retainer (periodic fixed fee). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hourly|flat_fee|contingency|afa|blended_rate|retainer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: fee_writedown_amount
attributes.description: Negative adjustment applied to WIP fees to reduce the billed amount below the standard rate value. Reflects billing guideline compliance, client relationship management, or billing attorney discretion. Stored as a positive number representing the reduction.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: fee_writeup_amount
attributes.description: Positive adjustment applied to WIP fees to increase the billed amount above the standard rate value. Reflects premium billing for exceptional work, complexity, or successful outcomes. A zero value indicates no write-up was applied.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: generated_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the prebill draft was generated from the WIP ledger. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the prebill lifecycle.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: guideline_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of individual billing guideline violations detected on this prebill during automated compliance checking. A count of zero indicates full compliance. Used to prioritize prebill review effort.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; client-specific billing guideline agreements

attributes.name: narrative_edited
attributes.description: Indicates whether any time entry or disbursement narrative was edited during the prebill review process. True = narratives were modified; False = original narratives retained. Supports billing quality audit and Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) review.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) standards; American Bar Association (ABA)

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office responsible for this prebill. Supports revenue allocation, profitability reporting, and Revenue Per Equity Partner (RPE) calculations at the office level.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: on_account_credit_applied
attributes.description: Amount of retainer or on-account funds applied against this prebill to reduce the net amount due. Relevant for matters operating under a retainer or advance payment arrangement. Zero if no on-account funds are applied.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts) regulations; State Bar Associations

attributes.name: prebill_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the prebill draft. Used by billing staff and attorneys to reference the prebill during review and approval workflows. Format: PB-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: prebill_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the prebill in the billing quality control process. Drives routing logic: draft (initial WIP extraction), under_review (sent to billing attorney), approved (ready for invoice generation), rejected (returned for correction), on_hold (pending client instruction), cancelled (abandoned). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|rejected|on_hold|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Legal Project Management (LPM) standards

attributes.name: prior_balance_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding accounts receivable balance from prior invoices for this matter as of the prebill generation date. Displayed on the prebill for attorney awareness and collections follow-up context.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: proposed_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: Net disbursement amount proposed for invoicing after applying disbursement adjustments. Represents the billable expense total to be carried forward to the final invoice.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: proposed_fees_amount
attributes.description: Net fee amount proposed for invoicing after applying write-up and write-down adjustments to WIP fees. Equals wip_fees_amount plus fee_writeup_amount minus fee_writedown_amount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: proposed_total_amount
attributes.description: Total proposed invoice value combining adjusted fees and adjusted disbursements. This is the gross amount that will appear on the final invoice if the prebill is approved without further changes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the reviewing attorney when rejecting the prebill. Documents the basis for rejection (e.g., narrative edits required, rate corrections needed, time entries disputed) to guide billing staff corrections.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: sent_for_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prebill was dispatched to the billing attorney for review. Marks the transition from draft to under_review status. Used to measure prebill review cycle time.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Legal Project Management (LPM) standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this prebill record was extracted. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer. Expected values: elite_3e (Elite 3E Practice Management), aderant_expert (Aderant Expert Time and Billing).
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer data lineage standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Applicable tax (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) calculated on the proposed billable amounts. Jurisdiction-dependent; may be zero for exempt matters or jurisdictions where legal services are not taxable.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: timekeeper_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct timekeepers (attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants) whose time entries are included in this prebill. Used for staffing analysis and billing guideline compliance (e.g., restrictions on number of timekeepers per matter).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: total_hours_billed
attributes.description: Aggregate billable hours included in this prebill across all timekeepers and time entries within the billing period. Applicable for hourly and blended-rate fee arrangements.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the prebill record. Tracks changes during the review, editing, and approval workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: wip_disbursements_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of unbilled disbursement and expense entries extracted for this prebill before any adjustments. Includes hard costs (court fees, filing fees, expert witness fees) and soft costs (photocopying, postage).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: wip_fees_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of unbilled fee time entries (Work in Progress) extracted for this prebill before any adjustments. Represents the raw billable fees from timekeeper entries within the billing period.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: wip_total_amount
attributes.description: Combined gross value of all WIP fees and disbursements extracted for this prebill prior to any write-up, write-down, or adjustment. Equals wip_fees_amount plus wip_disbursements_amount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

products.name: invoice
products.description: Authoritative billing document issued to a client for legal services rendered on one or more matters. Captures invoice number, invoice date, billing period, total fees, total disbursements, tax amounts, discounts, net amount due, currency, and invoice status lifecycle (draft, issued, disputed, paid, partially paid, written off, credited). Supports LEDES 1998B and LEDES XML electronic billing formats for corporate clients and insurance carriers. Encompasses credit notes (negative invoices with credit reason, originating invoice reference, and application status) and LEDES e-billing portal submission tracking (submission date, format version, target portal, submission status, rejection reasons, and resubmission history). Provides complete invoice-to-payment lifecycle visibility including dispute resolution and collections integration.

Legal compliance teams track which regulatory obligation mandates ea
