attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.rfp_submission. Business justification: Won RFP submissions specify fee arrangement types and estimated values that directly govern fee arrangement creation. Pitch-to-revenue reporting and panel compliance tracking require tracing fee arran

attributes.name: sla_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.sla_template. Business justification: Fee arrangements in legal firms incorporate SLA commitments (response time guarantees, delivery milestones tied to fee structure). Legal operations teams link SLA templates to fee arrangements for bre

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tier. Business justification: Client service tier directly determines fee arrangement terms and AFA eligibility (Tier 1 clients receive different structures). Legal pricing teams set fee arrangements based on client tier. This lin

attributes.name: agreed_amount
attributes.description: The total agreed fee amount for flat fee, capped fee, retainer, subscription, and success fee arrangements. Represents the contractually committed monetary value. For hourly and blended rate arrangements, this field is null and rate fields govern billing. Expressed in the arrangement currency.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; LEDES; Elite 3E

attributes.name: amendment_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking amendments to the fee arrangement. Version 1 represents the original arrangement; subsequent amendments increment this counter. Supports audit trail and supersession chain tracking in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the partner or authorized approver who sanctioned this fee arrangement on behalf of the firm. Required for AFA arrangements above firm-defined approval thresholds. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee arrangement was formally approved by the authorized partner or pricing committee. Marks the transition from draft to active status and triggers engagement setup workflows in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: arrangement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the fee arrangement, used in client communications, engagement letters (LOE), and billing correspondence. Typically follows firm-defined numbering conventions in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee arrangement. Controls whether the arrangement is actively governing billing operations. Draft indicates pending approval; active indicates currently in force; suspended indicates temporarily paused; expired indicates past effective end date; terminated indicates early cancellation; superseded indicates replaced by a newer arrangement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed cadence at which invoices are generated and submitted to the client under this fee arrangement. Governs the prebilling cycle in Elite 3E and Aderant Expert. Milestone-based frequency requires milestone trigger configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|milestone|on_demand|upon_completion — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: blended_hourly_rate
attributes.description: Single agreed hourly rate applied uniformly across all timekeepers on the matter, regardless of individual timekeeper seniority or standard rate. Used for blended rate AFA arrangements. Null for non-blended arrangements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; UTBMS; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: contingency_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the recovery or settlement amount payable to the firm under a contingency fee arrangement. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 33.3333 for 33.33%). Null for non-contingency arrangement types. Governed by jurisdiction-specific caps on contingency fees.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; State Bar Association rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fee arrangement record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per firm data standards.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the fee arrangement amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Governs currency conversion rules during invoice generation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: discount_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated discount percentage applied to standard rates or fees under this arrangement. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.0000 for 10%). Reduces the billable amount during invoice generation. Supports client relationship management and competitive pricing strategies.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the fee arrangement becomes binding and governs billing for the associated matter or client portfolio. Aligns with the engagement commencement date in the Letter of Engagement (LOE).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: expense_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum disbursement or expense amount the firm may incur and bill to the client under this arrangement without prior written approval. Governs disbursement billing controls during invoice generation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: expenses_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether disbursements and out-of-pocket expenses are billable to the client under this fee arrangement. When false, all expenses are absorbed by the firm. Governs disbursement line inclusion during prebilling.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee arrangement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended arrangements. When populated, triggers review or renewal workflows in Elite 3E. Distinct from termination date which reflects early cancellation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: fee_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum billable amount under a capped fee or blended rate arrangement. WIP accrued beyond this threshold cannot be invoiced without client approval or a formal cap amendment. Enforced during prebilling in Elite 3E and Aderant Expert.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code identifying the primary legal jurisdiction governing this fee arrangement. Determines applicable professional conduct rules, fee cap regulations, tax treatment, and LEDES billing format requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Code of Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales; IBA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the fee arrangement record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per firm data standards.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (accountability)

attributes.name: ledes_billing_format
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Billing Format
attributes.description: LEDES electronic billing format required by the client for invoice submission. Governs the output format of invoices generated from this arrangement. Clients with e-billing portals (e.g., TyMetrix, Legal Tracker) mandate specific LEDES versions.
attributes.references: LEDES Oversight Committee; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the client is contractually required to remit payment. Standard terms include net-30, net-45, net-60. Used to calculate invoice due dates and trigger collections workflows in Elite 3E accounts receivable.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: portfolio_arrangement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee arrangement governs a portfolio of multiple matters for the same client rather than a single matter. Portfolio arrangements aggregate WIP and billing across matters and require consolidated invoice generation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: retainer_amount
attributes.description: Periodic retainer fee amount payable by the client under a retainer or subscription arrangement. Represents the recurring fixed payment that secures the firm's availability. Tracked against IOLTA trust account rules where applicable.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; IOLTA; Elite 3E

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the legal services scope covered by this fee arrangement. Defines the boundaries of work included within the agreed fee, distinguishing in-scope from out-of-scope services that would require a separate arrangement or amendment.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: success_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount payable as a success fee upon achievement of the defined trigger condition. Distinct from contingency_rate_pct which is percentage-based. Null for non-success-fee arrangements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E

attributes.name: success_fee_trigger
attributes.description: Narrative description of the milestone, outcome, or event that triggers the success fee component of the arrangement (e.g., deal closing, favourable judgment, regulatory approval). Applicable only to success fee and hybrid AFA arrangements.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether applicable taxes (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) are chargeable on invoices generated under this fee arrangement. Drives tax calculation logic in Elite 3E and Aderant Expert during invoice generation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; GDPR; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Applicable tax rate percentage (e.g., VAT, GST) applied to invoices generated under this arrangement when tax_applicable is true. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 20.0000 for 20% UK VAT). Null when tax_applicable is false.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee arrangement was early-terminated prior to its scheduled expiry date. Populated only when arrangement_status is terminated. Distinct from expiry_date which reflects the originally agreed end date.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the fee arrangement was terminated prior to its scheduled expiry. Supports client relationship analytics and risk management reporting. Populated only when arrangement_status is terminated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: matter_closed|client_request|firm_withdrawal|superseded|breach|regulatory|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E

attributes.name: utbms_task_code_set
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code Set
attributes.description: UTBMS task code set applicable to this fee arrangement, governing how time entries and disbursements are categorized for task-based billing. Required for LEDES-compliant invoice submission and client billing guideline compliance.
attributes.references: UTBMS; LEDES Oversight Committee; ABA; Elite 3E

attributes.name: wip_conversion_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing how accumulated WIP is converted to invoiced amounts under this fee arrangement. Determines the timing and method of WIP recognition during prebilling. Critical for revenue recognition and financial reporting under the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; UTBMS

attributes.name: write_off_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of WIP that the billing attorney may write off during prebilling without escalating to partner or management approval. Enforces write-off governance controls in Aderant Expert and Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

products.name: billing_payment
products.description: Transactional record of funds received from a client against one or more invoices, including the detailed allocation of received funds across outstanding invoices and line items. Captures payment date, payment method (wire transfer, cheque, ACH, credit card), amount received, currency, exchange rate, bank reference, remittance details, and per-invoice/per-line allocation amounts with allocation type (full, partial, retainer drawdown, trust transfer). Supports partial payments, overpayments, unapplied balances, retainer drawdowns, trust-to-office account transfers, and complex multi-matter payment scenarios. Feeds accounts receivable aging and collections workflows.

attributes.name: billing_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment transaction record in the billing system. Primary key for the payment data product.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: aml_kyc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_kyc_program. Business justification: Legal firms must screen payments under a specific AML/KYC program (FATF, SRA requirements). Tracing which AML program governed a payment's screening is a named compliance process; aml_screening_status

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client trust or IOLTA account from which funds were transferred, applicable when payment_type is 'trust_transfer' or 'retainer_drawdown'. Supports IOLTA compliance, trust accounting reconciliation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts) regulations; SRA Accounts Rules; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: billing_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the firm's internal bank account record into which the payment was deposited (e.g., operating account, IOLTA/trust account, client account). Supports bank reconciliation and IOLTA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA regulations; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Clients often remit payments referencing specific dockets/cases. Tracking payment-to-docket enables matter-level AR reconciliation, client account management, and litigation cost recovery tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary invoice satisfied by this payment. For partial or multi-invoice payments, the dominant invoice is recorded here; full allocation detail is captured in the payment allocation lines.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary matter against which this payment is applied. For multi-matter payments, the dominant or first-allocated matter is recorded here; full allocation detail is captured in the payment allocation lines.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: original_payment_billing_payment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payment record when this record represents a reversal, reapplication, or correction of a prior payment. Enables payment lineage tracing and audit trail for reversed and reprocessed payments.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; ISO 27001

attributes.name: paying_organisation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.organisation. Business justification: Corporate treasury departments often make payments on behalf of multiple subsidiaries/client_profiles. Tracking the paying organisation (which may differ from the client_profile's organisation) enable

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client who remitted the payment. Links the payment to the client master record for accounts receivable aging and collections tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: retainer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retainer agreement or retainer balance record from which funds are drawn, applicable when payment_type is 'retainer_drawdown'. Links the payment to the pre-paid retainer for balance tracking and client reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: trust_ledger_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trust.ledger_entry. Business justification: Billing payments drawn from trust must be traceable to the corresponding trust ledger entry recording the disbursement. This trust-to-office transfer reconciliation is a mandatory legal trust accounti

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Describes how the received funds are distributed across outstanding invoices. 'full' means the entire invoice balance is satisfied; 'partial' means only a portion of one or more invoices is covered; 'retainer_drawdown' means funds are drawn from a pre-paid retainer; 'trust_transfer' means funds originate from a client trust account; 'unapplied' means no allocation has been made yet.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; IOLTA regulations

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of the received funds that has been allocated and posted against one or more outstanding invoices. For fully applied payments, equals received_amount. For partially applied payments, is less than received_amount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: applied_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the received funds were allocated and posted against outstanding invoices in the billing system. May differ from received_date when payments are held in unapplied status pending client direction or prebilling approval.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: bank_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction reference number assigned by the receiving bank or payment processor for this payment (e.g., SWIFT UETR, CHAPS reference, ACH trace number, cheque number). Used for bank reconciliation, payment tracing, and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; FATF AML compliance; PCI DSS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the payment record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with record-keeping obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the currency in which the payment was received from the client (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing and foreign exchange reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); IBA International Bar Association

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Any prompt-payment or early-settlement discount granted to the client and applied at the time of payment, reducing the net amount required to satisfy the invoice. Distinct from write_off_amount which represents a negotiated fee reduction.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the received_amount from the payment currency to the firm's functional (base) currency at the time of receipt. A value of 1.0 indicates the payment was received in the firm's functional currency. Required for multi-currency AR reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IBA International Bar Association; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of fee arrangement under which the invoices satisfied by this payment were billed. 'hourly' is standard time-based billing; 'flat_fee' is a fixed amount per matter or task; 'contingency' is a percentage of recovery; 'afa' is an Alternative Fee Arrangement (AFA) such as capped fees or success fees; 'blended_rate' is a single rate across all timekeepers; 'retainer' is a pre-paid retainer arrangement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA (American Bar Association) Model Rules; UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System)

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The received_amount converted to the firm's functional (base) currency using the exchange_rate at the time of receipt. Used for consolidated financial reporting, PPP (Profit Per Partner), PEP (Profit Per Equity Partner), and RPE (Revenue Per Equity Partner) KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; IBA International Bar Association

attributes.name: gl_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this payment is posted in the General Ledger (GL). Used for period-close financial reporting, revenue recognition, and SOX compliance. May differ from the calendar month of received_date due to period-end adjustments.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; GAAP/IFRS financial reporting standards

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was posted to the firm's General Ledger (GL), which may differ from the received_date or applied_date due to period-end cut-off rules. Critical for financial period reporting, SOX compliance, and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; GAAP/IFRS financial reporting standards

attributes.name: is_multi_matter
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been allocated across two or more matters. When True, the full allocation detail is captured in the payment allocation lines product. Supports complex multi-matter payment scenario reporting and client account management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment has been reversed (e.g., due to a returned cheque, failed ACH, or client dispute). When True, the reversal_date and reversal_reason fields are populated and the previously applied invoice balances are reinstated.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_trust_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment involves a transfer from a client trust or IOLTA account to the firm's operating account. When True, the payment is subject to IOLTA compliance rules and trust accounting reconciliation requirements.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts) regulations; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for billing staff to record additional context about the payment, such as client instructions, special allocation directions, collection negotiation notes, or explanations for partial payments. Not intended for structured data.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the received funds exceed the total outstanding balance of the invoices to which the payment was applied. A non-zero value requires a decision to refund, credit, or hold as a retainer. Supports client credit and refund workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA regulations; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The instrument or mechanism used by the client to remit funds. 'wire_transfer' covers SWIFT/CHAPS/SEPA bank wires; 'cheque' covers paper cheques; 'ach' covers ACH/BACS electronic transfers; 'credit_card' covers card payments; 'trust_transfer' covers transfers from the client's trust/IOLTA account to the office account; 'retainer_drawdown' covers application of a pre-paid retainer balance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA regulations; PCI DSS; FATF AML compliance

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the payment, used in client remittance advice, bank reconciliation, and collections correspondence. Follows the firm's sequential payment numbering convention (e.g., PAY-2024-000123).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment within the accounts receivable workflow. 'received' indicates funds have been confirmed in the bank; 'applied' means fully allocated to invoices; 'partially_applied' means some funds remain unapplied; 'unapplied' means no allocation has occurred; 'reversed' means the payment was reversed after application; 'voided' means the payment was cancelled before application.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the payment transaction for accounting and AR purposes. 'standard' is a regular client remittance; 'retainer_drawdown' is an application of a pre-paid retainer; 'trust_transfer' is a transfer from a client trust/IOLTA account; 'overpayment_credit' is a credit applied from a prior overpayment; 'write_off_reversal' is a recovery of a previously written-off amount.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA regulations; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of funds received from the client in the transaction currency, as confirmed by the bank or trust account statement. This is the authoritative amount before any exchange rate conversion or allocation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA regulations; PCI DSS

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the firm confirmed receipt of funds from the client, as recorded in the bank or trust account. This is the principal business event date used for accounts receivable aging, cash flow reporting, and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts) regulations

attributes.name: remittance_reference
attributes.description: The reference or description provided by the client on the remittance advice or payment instruction, typically including invoice numbers, matter references, or client-side purchase order numbers. Used to match incoming funds to outstanding invoices during cash application.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the payment was reversed in the billing system, reinstating the outstanding invoice balances. Populated only when is_reversed is True. Used for AR aging recalculation and collections workflow re-triggering.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the payment was reversed. 'returned_cheque' indicates a dishonoured cheque; 'failed_ach' indicates a failed electronic transfer; 'client_dispute' indicates the client contested the payment; 'duplicate_payment' indicates the payment was made twice; 'bank_error' indicates a banking error; 'other' covers miscellaneous reasons. Populated only when is_reversed is True.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; FATF AML compliance

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the received funds that has not yet been allocated to any invoice (received_amount minus applied_amount). A non-zero value triggers follow-up in the collections and AR workflow. Supports unapplied balance reporting and client credit management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the payment record, including status changes, allocation updates, or reversal processing. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: wip_cleared_amount
attributes.description: The amount of Work in Progress (WIP) that was cleared from the WIP ledger as a result of this payment being applied. Relevant for contingency and AFA matters where WIP is recognized upon collection rather than billing. Supports WIP management and revenue recognition reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; ABA (American Bar Association) financial reporting standards

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the outstanding invoice balance that was written off in conjunction with this payment, representing the difference between the invoiced amount and the amount the client agreed to pay (e.g., in a negotiated settlement or fee reduction). Supports bad debt reporting and partner write-off approval workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX Section 404

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoice lines, capturing how received funds are distributed across outstanding invoices and line items. Tracks allocated amount, allocation date, allocation type (full, partial, retainer drawdown, trust transfer), and any unapplied balance. Ensures accurate AR aging and supports complex multi-matter payment scenarios common in large corporate client relationships.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment allocation record. Primary key for the payment_allocation data product in the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IOLTA or client trust account from which funds were drawn for this allocation, when allocation_type is 'trust_transfer'. Required for trust accounting compliance and state bar regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); State Bar Associations; American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: billing_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment record from which funds are being allocated. Links this allocation to the originating payment transaction.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Payment allocations are applied to invoices for specific dockets. Required for matter-level AR accuracy, client account reconciliation, and litigation profitability tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice against which this allocation is applied. Supports multi-invoice payment scenarios common in large corporate client matters.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: invoice_line_id

attributes.name: matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter associated with this payment allocation. Supports multi-matter payment scenarios where a single client payment is distributed across multiple active matters.

attributes.description: Reference to the client entity making the payment. Enables client-level AR aging analysis and supports consolidated billing for clients with multiple matters.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment being applied to the referenced invoice or invoice line. Core financial field for AR aging, cash application, and revenue recognition. Must be positive and not exceed the payment's unapplied balance.

attributes.name: allocated_amount_base
attributes.description: The allocated amount expressed in the firm's functional (base) currency after applying the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, PPP, PEP, and RPE KPI calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment allocation was applied to the invoice. Determines the AR aging bucket reduction and is the principal event date for cash application reporting and period-end close.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this payment allocation record, used in client communications, remittance advice reconciliation, and audit trails. Typically follows firm-defined numbering conventions in Elite 3E or Aderant Expert.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment allocation record. 'posted' indicates funds have been applied to the invoice; 'reversed' indicates a corrective reversal has been processed; 'pending' indicates awaiting approval or trust transfer confirmation; 'voided' indicates the allocation was cancelled; 'unapplied' indicates funds received but not yet matched to an invoice.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the payment is being applied. 'full' covers the entire outstanding balance; 'partial' covers a portion; 'retainer_drawdown' applies funds held in a retainer account; 'trust_transfer' applies funds from an IOLTA trust account; 'write_off_offset' offsets a previously written-off amount; 'credit_memo' applies a credit note against the invoice balance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IOLTA (Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts); Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this payment allocation, particularly relevant for trust transfers and write-off offsets that require partner or billing manager sign-off per firm policy.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the billing manager, partner, or authorized approver who approved this payment allocation. Required for audit trail and compliance with firm billing governance policies.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the payment allocation was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the allocation lifecycle audit trail.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this payment allocation record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for financial records.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing in international legal matters, particularly relevant for ICC and LCIA arbitration matters.

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the allocated amount from the payment currency to the firm's functional currency at the time of allocation. Relevant for cross-border matters billed in non-functional currencies.

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type

attributes.name: gl_post_date

attributes.name: invoice_balance_after

attributes.name: invoice_balance_before

attributes.name: reversed_timestamp

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The firm's fiscal year and month in which the write-off is recognized for financial reporting purposes, formatted as YYYY-MM. Derived from gl_posting_date but stored explicitly to support period-based aggregation and financial close reporting without date arithmetic.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The write-off amount converted to the firm's functional (home) currency using the exchange_rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, partner compensation calculations (PPP/PEP), and firm-wide realization rate analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the write-off is posted to the General Ledger. Determines the financial period (month/quarter/year) in which the write-off impacts the firm's P&L and balance sheet. May differ from write_off_date due to period-end cut-off rules.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: hours_written_off
attributes.description: The number of billable hours associated with the write-off, applicable when the write-off relates to time entries. Null for expense or disbursement write-offs. Used to calculate effective realization rates and to measure the volume of written-off effort.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off record is a reversal of a previously posted write-off (True) or an original write-off entry (False). Reversals restore WIP or AR balances and must be tracked separately for accurate net write-off reporting and GL reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or commentary entered by billing staff, the approving partner, or finance team regarding the write-off. May include client negotiation context, matter budget discussions, or collections history relevant to bad debt write-offs.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office (geographic location) associated with the matter or billing timekeeper at the time of write-off. Supports office-level financial performance reporting and regional realization rate analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The gross value of the WIP or AR balance before the write-off is applied, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the full amount at standard rates prior to any reduction. Used as the denominator in realization rate calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES; GAAP

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the write-off (e.g., client billing guideline non-compliance, rate cap exceeded, duplicate entry, uncollectable debt, client relationship courtesy, matter budget overrun). Sourced from Elite 3E or Aderant Expert reason code tables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_guideline|rate_cap|duplicate_entry|bad_debt|courtesy|budget_overrun|staffing_level|task_not_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; UTBMS

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the billing timekeeper or approving partner describing the specific circumstances justifying the write-off. Supplements the structured reason_code with contextual detail for audit and partner review purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: requires_secondary_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off amount exceeds the firm's threshold requiring secondary approval (e.g., managing partner or finance committee sign-off in addition to the billing partner). Supports tiered approval workflow governance and write-off policy compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SOX

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this write-off record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and audit traceability in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier or transaction reference of this write-off record in the originating source system (Elite 3E or Aderant Expert). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: The timekeeper's standard hourly billing rate at the time the original WIP entry was recorded. Used to calculate the standard value of hours written off and to measure rate realization impact. Null for flat-fee or expense write-offs.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Elite 3E

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was last modified in the system of record or the lakehouse Silver layer. Tracks status changes, approval updates, and corrections. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per firm data conventions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; SOX

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: The UTBMS activity code associated with the time entry being written off. Provides granular activity-level classification for task-based billing analysis and client billing guideline compliance reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: The UTBMS task code associated with the time or expense entry being written off. Enables task-level write-off analysis aligned with client billing guidelines and AFA arrangements. Supports LEDES electronic billing compliance reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); ABA

attributes.name: wip_entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original WIP time or expense entry being written off was recorded. Used to calculate WIP aging at the time of write-off and to assess how long unbilled time was carried before being written off. Null for AR (post-billing) write-offs.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: write_down_amount
attributes.description: The partial reduction amount when a write-down (as opposed to a full write-off) is applied. Represents the difference between original_amount and the revised billable amount. Null for full write-offs. Supports partial realization analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; GAAP

attributes.name: write_off_category
attributes.description: Distinguishes whether the write-off applies to professional fees (timekeeper charges), disbursements (client-incurred costs), firm expenses, accrued interest on overdue AR, or tax components. Drives GL account mapping and realization rate segmentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; UTBMS

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the write-off was formally approved and recorded. This is the principal real-world event date used for financial period close, WIP aging, and realization rate calculations. Distinct from the system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the write-off transaction, typically generated by Elite 3E or Aderant Expert. Used in partner approval workflows, GL postings, and audit trails. Format: WO-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the write-off transaction. Tracks the workflow from initial submission through partner approval, GL posting, and potential reversal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_approval|approved|rejected|reversed|posted|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: write_off_type
attributes.description: Classification of the write-off by its business nature. WIP write-off reduces unbilled time/expense value; bad debt eliminates uncollectable AR; courtesy discount reflects client relationship adjustments; billing guideline reduction reflects client-mandated rate or task reductions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wip_write_off|bad_debt|courtesy_discount|billing_guideline_reduction|fee_waiver|expense_write_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); Elite 3E

products.name: retainer
products.description: Master record of client retainer arrangements including general retainers, matter-specific retainers, and evergreen retainers. Tracks retainer amount, replenishment threshold, current balance, drawdown history, retainer type, and associated trust account reference. Distinct from IOLTA trust accounts (owned by the trust domain) — this entity governs the commercial retainer agreement terms and drawdown authorization rules within the billing cycle.

attributes.name: retainer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the retainer arrangement record. Primary key for the retainer data product within the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts (IOLTA) or client trust account record in the trust accounting domain. Governs the custodial account from which retainer drawdowns are funded.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; IOLTA Program Standards

Trust accounting and retainer drawdown rules must reference the governing LOE to ensure compliance with agreed

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.matter_risk_profile. Business justification: AML/KYC risk reporting: retainer adequacy and kyc_verified_flag are assessed against the matter risk profile (aml_risk_flag, sanctions_screening_required_flag). Legal compliance teams link retainers t

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Retainers in legal firms are frequently scoped to a specific practice area (e.g., employment law retainer, IP prosecution retainer). Legal finance teams track retainer utilization and replenishment by

attributes.description: Reference to the client for whom this retainer arrangement has been established. Links the retainer to the client master record.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Intapp Conflicts

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.request. Business justification: Intake requests specify whether a retainer is required as a condition of engagement. Linking retainers to the authorizing intake request supports trust account compliance audits and AML/KYC regulatory

attributes.name: retainer_ledes_client_matter_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Client Matter ID
attributes.description: The client-assigned matter identifier formatted per the Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) specification. Required for electronic billing submissions to corporate clients and insurance carriers that mandate LEDES-format invoices.
attributes.references: LEDES Billing Standard; Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS); Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: retainer_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific matter associated with this retainer. Null for general retainers that span all matters for a client; populated for matter-specific retainers.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: sar_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sar_filing. Business justification: Retainer receipts are screened for AML red flags and may trigger SAR (large cash retainers, third-party funding, high-risk jurisdictions). Real business process: client funds acceptance and AML compli

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tier. Business justification: Retainer terms (amount, replenishment thresholds, drawdown rules) are tier-dependent in legal firms. Tier 1 clients receive different retainer structures than standard clients. Legal finance teams str

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retainer arrangement was formally approved by the responsible partner or governance authority. Supports audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the partner or authorised signatory who approved the establishment of this retainer arrangement. Required for governance and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct; SRA Code of Conduct; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: auto_apply_to_invoice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether retainer funds should be automatically applied to reduce the outstanding balance of invoices upon generation, without requiring manual partner approval for each drawdown.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which fees are drawn against the retainer and invoices are generated. Drives the billing cycle schedule in the practice management system.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: billing_office_code
attributes.description: The office or cost centre code responsible for billing and administering this retainer. Used for revenue allocation, profit centre reporting, and Profit Per Partner (PPP) / Profit Per Equity Partner (PEP) analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this retainer record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 802

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the retainer amount, balance, and all drawdown transactions are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency billing for international clients.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES Billing Standard; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance of the retainer after all drawdowns and replenishments have been applied. Represents the remaining funds authorised for future billing drawdowns. Updated upon each drawdown event or replenishment receipt.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: drawdown_authorization_rule
attributes.description: The rule governing when and how funds may be drawn from the retainer balance against earned fees or disbursements. Automatic drawdown applies retainer funds upon invoice generation; manual approval requires explicit partner sign-off; threshold-triggered drawdown applies when WIP reaches a defined level; periodic scheduled drawdown occurs on a fixed calendar basis.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; SRA Accounts Rules; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: drawdown_via_payment
attributes.description: FK to billing.payment.payment_id — Retainer drawdowns are processed as payment applications. This FK connects retainer balance management to the payment/AR cycle.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retainer arrangement becomes binding and drawdowns may commence. Corresponds to the commencement date stated in the Letter of Engagement (LOE) or retainer agreement.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: evergreen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retainer is structured as an evergreen arrangement, meaning the client is contractually obligated to replenish the balance to the target amount whenever it falls below the replenishment threshold. Drives automated replenishment demand workflows.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retainer arrangement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended or evergreen retainers with no fixed end date. After this date, no further drawdowns are authorised without renewal.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retainer funds held in the associated trust account are subject to interest accrual under IOLTA or client-specific interest arrangements. True if interest is earned and must be reported or remitted.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15; IOLTA Program Standards; Internal Revenue Service (IRS) reporting requirements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The primary legal jurisdiction governing the retainer arrangement and the associated client engagement. Determines applicable professional conduct rules, trust accounting regulations, and tax treatment. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; American Bar Association (ABA); Law Society of England and Wales; International Bar Association (IBA); SRA

attributes.name: kyc_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client associated with this retainer has completed Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification checks prior to the retainer being activated. Mandatory for regulatory compliance before funds are accepted.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) AML Recommendations; SRA Anti-Money Laundering Regulations; Law Society of England and Wales AML Guidance; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: last_drawdown_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent drawdown was applied against this retainer. Used for activity monitoring, dormancy detection, and collections follow-up.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this retainer record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation, and audit trail purposes across the billing domain.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 802

attributes.name: last_replenishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent replenishment payment was received and applied to this retainer balance. Used for cash flow monitoring and client payment behaviour analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplementary information about the retainer arrangement, including special billing instructions, client-specific conditions, or internal administrative notes not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The initial monetary amount deposited or committed by the client when the retainer arrangement was established. Represents the starting balance before any drawdowns or replenishments. Expressed in the billing currency.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: practice_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the practice group (e.g., Corporate, Litigation, Intellectual Property, Employment) under which this retainer is administered. Supports revenue reporting by practice area and Revenue Per Equity Partner (RPE) analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS)

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any unused retainer balance is refundable to the client upon matter closure or retainer termination. Governs the treatment of residual balances in the billing close-out process.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: replenishment_demand_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent replenishment demand was issued to the client. Used to track outstanding replenishment requests and calculate days outstanding for collections follow-up.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: replenishment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the client must remit the replenishment amount following a demand. Drives collections escalation workflows when payment is not received by this date.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: replenishment_target_amount
attributes.description: The amount to which the retainer balance should be restored upon replenishment. May equal the original_amount or a separately negotiated top-up level. Used to calculate the replenishment demand sent to the client.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: replenishment_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum balance level at which a replenishment request is automatically triggered and sent to the client. When current_balance falls at or below this threshold, the firm initiates a top-up demand. Critical for evergreen retainer management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: retainer_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the retainer arrangement. Used in client correspondence, billing statements, and engagement letters. Format: RET-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: retainer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retainer arrangement. Active indicates funds are available for drawdown; exhausted indicates the balance has been fully applied; replenishment_pending indicates a top-up request has been issued to the client; closed indicates the arrangement has been formally terminated.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: retainer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the retainer arrangement by its commercial structure. General retainers cover all matters for a client; matter-specific retainers are scoped to a single matter; evergreen retainers auto-replenish; security retainers are held as collateral; advance payment retainers are pre-payments for future services.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Law Society of England and Wales Practice Guidance

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fees drawn against this retainer are exempt from applicable taxes (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) based on the client's tax status or the nature of the legal services provided.
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); jurisdiction-specific tax authority requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the retainer arrangement was formally closed or terminated, either upon matter completion, client withdrawal, or firm-initiated closure. Null for active retainers.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the retainer arrangement was closed or terminated. Used for client relationship analytics and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.16; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: total_drawn_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary amount drawn down from this retainer since its establishment. Represents the sum of all drawdown transactions applied against earned fees and disbursements. Used for retainer utilisation reporting and client billing transparency.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

attributes.name: total_replenished_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary amount received from the client as retainer replenishments since the arrangement was established. Tracks all top-up receipts to support reconciliation and client account management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.15

attributes.name: under_fee_arrangement
attributes.description: FK to billing.fee_arrangement.fee_arrangement_id — Retainers are a component of the overall fee arrangement with a client. Linking retainer to fee_arrangement ensures the retainer terms are governed by the broader commercial agreement.

attributes.name: wip_drawdown_limit
attributes.description: The maximum Work in Progress (WIP) amount that may accumulate before a mandatory drawdown against the retainer is triggered. Prevents unbilled WIP from exceeding the retainer balance and ensures timely billing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert

products.name: guideline
products.description: Master record of client-specific billing guidelines and outside counsel guidelines (OCG) that govern invoice compliance requirements. Captures guideline source (client-issued OCG, engagement letter, standing instruction), rule type (rate cap, timekeeper approval, task code restriction, narrative requirement, block billing prohibition, expense limit), effective date, and enforcement action. Used during prebilling review and LEDES submission validation to flag non-compliant entries before invoice issuance.
