attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.tier. Business justification: Billing guidelines are tier-specific in legal firms (different rate caps, expense limits, and timekeeper approval requirements apply to different client tiers). Legal billing compliance teams apply an

attributes.name: afa_type
attributes.description: The fee arrangement type governed by this guideline. Identifies whether the guideline applies to hourly billing, a flat fee, contingency, blended rate, capped fee, or success fee arrangement. Aligns with the firm's AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) billing model.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: applies_to_expenses
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing guideline applies to expense/disbursement entries in addition to or instead of time entries. When True, expense line items are subject to the same rule enforcement during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: applies_to_time_entries
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing guideline applies to time entries. When True, time entry records are subject to the rule enforcement during prebilling review and LEDES submission validation.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the partner, billing manager, or client representative who approved this billing guideline for enforcement. Provides accountability and audit trail for guideline activation.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing guideline was formally approved for enforcement. Distinct from effective_from, which is the date the rule becomes binding on billing entries.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: block_billing_prohibited
attributes.description: Indicates whether block billing (combining multiple tasks into a single time entry without itemisation) is prohibited under this guideline. When True, prebilling review must flag any time entries containing multiple tasks in a single narrative.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: budget_cap_amount
attributes.description: Total matter-level or phase-level budget ceiling imposed by the client under this guideline. When WIP (Work in Progress) approaches or exceeds this cap, alerts are triggered for partner review before further billing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing guideline record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this billing guideline becomes binding and enforceable. Time entries and expenses incurred on or after this date are subject to the rule. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this billing guideline ceases to be enforceable. Null indicates an open-ended guideline with no defined expiry. Used to determine which version of a guideline applies to a given billing period.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: enforcement_action
attributes.description: The system action triggered when a non-compliant entry is detected during prebilling review or LEDES submission validation. hard_block prevents invoice issuance; soft_warning alerts the billing team; write_off automatically reduces the entry; require_approval routes to partner; flag_for_review marks for manual review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Prebilling; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any agreed exceptions or carve-outs to this billing guideline, such as approved deviations negotiated with the client or specific matter circumstances where the rule does not apply.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: expense_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum allowable disbursement or expense amount per transaction or per category as defined by this guideline. Populated when rule_type is expense_limit. Used to flag non-compliant expense entries during prebilling review.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: guideline_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the billing rule, including any conditions, exceptions, or qualifications. Provides the complete business context for the guideline as communicated by the client or as agreed in the engagement letter.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or short title of the billing guideline, such as 'Block Billing Prohibition' or 'Senior Associate Rate Cap'. Used for display in prebilling dashboards and compliance reports.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating document or instrument from which this billing guideline derives its authority. Values: ocg (client-issued Outside Counsel Guidelines), engagement_letter (Letter of Engagement / LOE), standing_instruction (ongoing client instruction), matter_specific_agreement (matter-level side agreement), court_order (court-mandated billing restriction).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: guideline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing guideline. Active guidelines are enforced during prebilling review. Superseded guidelines are retained for historical audit. Pending_approval guidelines are awaiting client or partner sign-off before enforcement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: invoice_submission_deadline_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days after the billing period end date within which the firm must submit an invoice to the client. Late submissions beyond this threshold may be subject to write-off or rejection per the OCG.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Billing; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: invoice_submission_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency at which invoices must be submitted to the client under this guideline. Governs billing cycle compliance and WIP (Work in Progress) management cadence.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Billing

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code) to which this billing guideline applies. Relevant for multi-jurisdictional matters where different billing rules may apply per jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; International Bar Association (IBA); Law Society of England and Wales

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this billing guideline was reviewed for continued applicability and accuracy. Supports periodic OCG review cycles and ensures guidelines remain current with client instructions.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: ledes_billing_format
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard (LEDES) Billing Format
attributes.description: The required LEDES electronic billing format version mandated by the client for invoice submission under this guideline. Governs the file format used when submitting invoices electronically to the client or their e-billing platform.
attributes.references: LEDES Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard; Aderant Expert Billing

attributes.name: minimum_time_increment_mins
attributes.description: The minimum billable time increment in minutes permitted under this guideline (e.g., 6 minutes = 0.1 hour, 15 minutes = 0.25 hour). Time entries rounded to increments larger than this value may be flagged as non-compliant.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Time Entry

attributes.name: narrative_min_length
attributes.description: Minimum number of characters required in a time entry or expense narrative to satisfy the client's narrative requirement under this guideline. Entries with narratives shorter than this threshold are flagged during prebilling review.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Prebilling

attributes.name: new_timekeeper_rate_freeze
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has imposed a rate freeze on newly introduced timekeepers, requiring them to bill at the same rate as the timekeeper they replace or at a pre-agreed rate. Common OCG provision to control staffing cost escalation.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Rate Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: ocg_section_reference
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or paragraph number within the OCG document that contains the rule captured by this guideline record. Supports precise audit trail and dispute resolution when a billing entry is challenged.
attributes.references: iManage Work Document Management System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: rate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum hourly billing rate permitted under this guideline for the applicable timekeeper level or role. Populated only when rule_type is rate_cap. Enforced during prebilling review to flag time entries exceeding the agreed rate ceiling.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; Aderant Expert Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_cap_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the rate_cap_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required when rate_cap_amount is populated to ensure multi-currency billing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rate_increase_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice the firm must provide to the client before implementing a rate increase under this guideline. Enforces the client's OCG requirement for rate change notification.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the client or law firm to uniquely reference this Outside Counsel Guideline (OCG) or billing instruction document. Used for cross-referencing with client-issued OCG documents.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the billing rule for reporting and filtering purposes. Segments guidelines into operational categories: timekeeper (rate and staffing rules), expense (disbursement rules), invoice_format (LEDES/UTBMS formatting), matter_budget (budget and cap rules), task_code (UTBMS task code restrictions), narrative (time entry description requirements).
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the billing rule being enforced. Defines the nature of the compliance requirement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_cap|timekeeper_approval|task_code_restriction|narrative_requirement|block_billing_prohibition|expense_limit|staffing_restriction|budget_cap|write_off_threshold|invoice_format_requirement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: timekeeper_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether timekeepers must be pre-approved by the client before their time can be billed under this guideline. When True, any time entry from a non-approved timekeeper is flagged as non-compliant during prebilling review.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5

attributes.name: timekeeper_level
attributes.description: The seniority or role classification of the timekeeper to which this guideline applies. Used to scope rate caps and staffing restrictions to specific timekeeper grades. 'all' indicates the rule applies universally regardless of timekeeper level.
attributes.references: Aderant Expert Timekeeper Management; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing guideline record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: utbms_activity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Activity Code
attributes.description: The UTBMS activity code (e.g., A101 Plan and Prepare, A102 Research) to which this guideline applies. Used in conjunction with utbms_task_code to restrict or govern specific task-activity combinations in LEDES invoice submissions.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: The UTBMS task code to which this guideline applies when rule_type is task_code_restriction. Identifies the specific legal task category (e.g., L110 Fact Investigation, L120 Analysis/Strategy) that is restricted or governed by this rule.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES Billing Standard

attributes.name: wip_aging_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days that unbilled WIP (Work in Progress) may remain outstanding before it must be billed or written off per the client's guideline. Supports WIP management and collections compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Collections

products.name: invoice_dispute
products.description: Transactional record of client-raised disputes or reductions against a submitted invoice. Captures dispute date, disputed amount, dispute reason (billing guideline violation, rate discrepancy, duplicate entry, unauthorized timekeeper, narrative deficiency), resolution status, agreed reduction amount, and resolution date. Supports dispute resolution workflow and feeds realization rate and write-off analytics.

attributes.name: invoice_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each invoice dispute record. Primary key for the invoice_dispute data product within the billing domain.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Invoice disputes citing billing guideline violations or contractual terms require direct access to governing agreement. Dispute resolution reviews contractual billing terms, escalation workflows pull

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_contact. Business justification: Invoice disputes are raised by a specific client contact. The plain attributes `client_contact_email` and `client_contact_name` on invoice_dispute are denormalized representations of client.client_con

attributes.name: credit_note_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_note. Business justification: Invoice disputes often result in credit notes being issued to adjust the disputed amount. Currently invoice_dispute has credit_note_number (string) but no FK to the credit_note record. Adding credit_n

attributes.name: disputed_time_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific time entry record being disputed, where the dispute is at the line-item level. Null when the dispute applies to multiple entries or the full invoice. Enables granular WIP (Work in Progress) and realization analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Invoice disputes arise from specific litigation matters/dockets. Essential for dispute resolution, client relationship management, and matter-level billing accuracy in court cases.

attributes.name: indemnity_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.indemnity_claim. Business justification: Invoice disputes can escalate to professional indemnity claims (alleged overbilling, negligence, guideline violations). Real business process: dispute escalation to PI claim requires linking disputes

attributes.name: legal_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.legal_document. Business justification: Invoice disputes reference supporting documents (billing guidelines, engagement letters, court orders, fee agreements) for resolution. Critical for dispute substantiation, write-off justification, and

attributes.name: letter_of_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.letter_of_engagement. Business justification: Invoice disputes are adjudicated against LOE terms covering agreed scope, rates, and billing guidelines. Disputes teams must pull the LOE to determine whether a disputed charge was within agreed scope

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.obligation. Business justification: Invoice disputes in legal services arise from specific contract obligations (rate caps, expense limits, billing guideline clauses). Linking to the specific obligation being disputed enables obligation

attributes.name: pi_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pi_claim. Business justification: Dispute-to-PI-claim escalation tracking: invoice disputes that allege negligence or breach of duty escalate to formal PI claims. Legal risk teams need to link the originating invoice_dispute to the re

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Invoice disputes are resolved by practice area leadership with area-specific resolution authority and client relationship management. Practice area determines dispute resolution approach, approval aut

attributes.name: primary_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice against which this dispute has been raised. Links the dispute to the originating billing document in the accounts receivable cycle.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: primary_invoice_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter associated with the disputed invoice. Enables dispute analysis by practice area, matter type, and responsible attorney.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client who raised the invoice dispute. Supports client-level dispute trend analysis and relationship management reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_register. Business justification: Significant invoice disputes (especially pattern disputes or high-value disputes) are logged in the risk register as client relationship, reputational, and financial risk events. Firms track dispute-t

attributes.name: tertiary_invoice_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.invoice.invoice_id — Disputes are raised against specific invoices. This FK enables dispute tracking, resolution workflow, and realization impact analysis.

attributes.name: agreed_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount agreed between the firm and the client as the final reduction to the invoice following dispute resolution. May be less than, equal to, or zero relative to the disputed amount. Feeds write-off and realization rate calculations.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: billing_guideline_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client billing guideline clause or section that the client alleges was violated. Supports billing guideline compliance tracking and AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) governance.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; client-specific billing guidelines; AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) governance

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice. Used in conjunction with billing_period_start to define the scope of time entries and disbursements subject to the dispute.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by the disputed invoice. Provides temporal context for the dispute and supports period-based realization rate and WIP (Work in Progress) analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the invoice dispute record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the disputed and agreed reduction amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing environments and cross-border matter reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: days_to_resolve
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed between the dispute_date and the resolution_date. Null while the dispute remains open. Supports SLA compliance measurement and dispute cycle time benchmarking. Note: this is a stored operational field populated at resolution, not a real-time derived metric.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the client formally raised the invoice dispute. Serves as the principal business event date for aging calculations, SLA tracking, and realization rate analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the dispute at the time of creation. Used in client correspondence, billing guideline audit trails, and LEDES-compliant dispute tracking. Format: DISP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized UTBMS-aligned code categorizing the primary reason the client raised the dispute. Drives root-cause analytics and billing guideline compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_guideline_violation|rate_discrepancy|duplicate_entry|unauthorized_timekeeper|narrative_deficiency|block_billing|excessive_time|staffing_objection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: dispute_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the client or billing team elaborating on the specific grounds for the dispute. Supplements the structured reason code with contextual detail for resolution workflow and knowledge management.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the invoice dispute. Drives the dispute resolution lifecycle from initial submission through final resolution or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_review|pending_client|resolved|withdrawn|escalated — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispute by the category of charge being contested: fees, disbursements, rates, specific timekeeper entries, or the entire invoice. Enables segmented dispute analytics by charge type.
attributes.references: UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System); LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount the client is disputing on the invoice, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the client's claimed reduction before any negotiation or resolution. Core input to realization rate and write-off analytics.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard)

attributes.name: ebilling_platform
attributes.description: Name of the client's electronic billing platform through which the dispute was submitted (e.g., TyMetrix 360, Legal Tracker, BillerXpert, Passport). Supports e-billing integration and dispute channel analytics.
attributes.references: LEDES (Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard); client billing guideline governance

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute was escalated to senior management or the responsible partner. Null if the dispute has not been escalated. Supports escalation trend analysis and client relationship risk monitoring.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LPM (Legal Project Management) governance

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute has been escalated beyond the standard billing team to senior management, the responsible partner, or the client relationship team. True when escalated; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LPM (Legal Project Management) governance

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of fee arrangement under which the disputed invoice was generated. Contextualizes the dispute within the applicable billing framework (e.g., AFA disputes differ structurally from hourly billing disputes).
attributes.references: AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) governance; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total billed amount on the original invoice at the time the dispute was raised. Provides denominator context for calculating the dispute percentage and realization rate impact.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: lpp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any communications or documents associated with this dispute are subject to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP). True when LPP applies; False otherwise. Governs disclosure obligations and eDiscovery handling of dispute records.
attributes.references: LPP (Legal Professional Privilege); ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct; Law Society of England and Wales; SRA (Solicitors Regulation Authority)

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office (e.g., LON, NYC, HKG) responsible for the matter associated with the disputed invoice. Supports geographic segmentation of dispute analytics and office-level realization rate reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the dispute was received and logged in the billing system. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) response-time measurement and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the invoice dispute was formally resolved and a final outcome agreed between the firm and the client. Null while the dispute remains open. Used to calculate dispute cycle time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the rationale, negotiation outcome, and any conditions agreed during dispute resolution. Supports knowledge management, precedent tracking, and future billing guideline refinement.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the outcome of the dispute resolution process: whether the firm accepted the full disputed amount, a partial reduction, rejected the dispute, issued a credit note, wrote off the amount, or the client withdrew the dispute.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this dispute record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ISO 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the invoice dispute record. Enables change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: write_off_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreed reduction amount has been formally approved as a write-off in the firm's financial system. True when write-off approval has been granted; False when pending or not applicable. Feeds write-off analytics and PPP/PEP impact reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) financial controls

attributes.name: write_off_approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off of the agreed reduction amount was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., managing partner, billing committee). Null if write-off has not been approved. Supports financial period close and SOX controls.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) financial controls

products.name: credit_note
products.description: Transactional record of credit notes issued to clients to reverse or reduce previously invoiced amounts. Captures credit note number, originating invoice reference, credit reason (overbilling, dispute resolution, goodwill adjustment, fee cap correction), credit amount, tax adjustment, issuance date, and application status (applied to outstanding AR, refunded, held on account). Supports realization rate analysis and AR reconciliation.

attributes.name: credit_note_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the credit note record in the billing system. Primary key for the credit_note data product.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: docket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to court.docket. Business justification: Credit notes adjust billing for specific litigation matters/dockets. Required for accurate matter-level revenue recognition, client account reconciliation, and litigation profitability tracking.

attributes.name: indemnity_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.indemnity_claim. Business justification: Credit notes issued as part of PI claim settlement or remediation (fee reductions, goodwill credits). Real business process: claim resolution financial adjustments require linking credit notes to clai

attributes.name: indemnity_exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.indemnity_exposure. Business justification: PI settlement cost reporting: credit notes issued as part of indemnity exposure settlements must be linked to the exposure record for reserve drawdown tracking and insurer reporting. Legal risk manage

attributes.name: legal_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.legal_document. Business justification: Credit notes reference supporting documents (court orders reducing fees, settlement agreements, billing guideline violations). Required for credit justification, audit trails, and regulatory complianc

attributes.name: pi_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pi_claim. Business justification: PI claim settlement reporting: credit notes issued as fee concessions in PI claim settlements must reference the pi_claim record. Legal risk and finance teams use this link to reconcile settlement_amo

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Credit notes impact practice area P&L and require area leader approval. Practice area determines approval authority, revenue adjustment policies, and profitability reporting used in financial manageme

attributes.name: primary_credit_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating invoice against which this credit note is issued. Establishes the parent-child relationship between the credit note and the billed invoice for accounts receivable (AR) reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: primary_credit_matter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter or case associated with the credit note. Enables matter-level profitability analysis and WIP (Work in Progress) reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity to whom the credit note is issued. Used for client-level AR reconciliation, realization rate analysis, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Describes how the credit note value was or will be applied. 'applied_to_ar' — offset against an existing outstanding AR balance on the client account; 'cash_refund' — disbursed as a cash payment back to the client; 'held_on_account' — retained as a credit balance for future invoices; 'offset_future_invoice' — earmarked to reduce a specific forthcoming invoice.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; IOLTA Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts rules

attributes.name: applied_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit note was applied against an outstanding AR balance or processed as a cash refund. Null if the credit note has not yet been applied (status is 'issued' or 'held'). Used for AR ageing and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the credit note was formally approved by the authorised approver (approved_by_id). Supports approval workflow audit trails and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; SRA Accounts Rules

attributes.name: billing_guideline_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the client billing guideline or outside counsel guidelines (OCG) provision that triggered or justified this credit note (e.g., a specific guideline clause number). Supports billing guideline compliance tracking and dispute resolution documentation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by the original invoice being credited. Together with billing_period_start_date, defines the revenue recognition period affected by this credit note.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 15; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by the original invoice being credited. Used to attribute the credit note to the correct accounting period for revenue recognition and WIP (Work in Progress) reversal.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the credit note record was first created in the billing system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) data processing records.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique identifier for the credit note as printed on the document issued to the client. Follows the firm's sequential numbering convention (e.g., CN-2024-000123). Used in client correspondence, remittance matching, and LEDES electronic billing submissions.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: credit_note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit note. 'draft' — prepared but not yet issued; 'issued' — sent to client; 'applied' — offset against an outstanding AR balance; 'refunded' — cash refund disbursed to client; 'held' — held on account for future application; 'voided' — cancelled and reversed.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: credit_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised classification of the business reason for issuing the credit note. 'overbilling' — fees or disbursements billed in excess of agreed rates; 'dispute_resolution' — credit issued as part of a formal billing dispute settlement; 'goodwill_adjustment' — discretionary reduction to maintain client relationship; 'fee_cap_correction' — invoice exceeded an agreed AFA (Alternative Fee Arrangement) or matter budget cap; 'billing_error' — administrative or data entry error on the original invoice; 'write_off' — uncollectable amount formally written off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overbilling|dispute_resolution|goodwill_adjustment|fee_cap_correction|billing_error|write_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5 (Fees); Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Code of Conduct

attributes.name: credit_reason_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description providing the detailed business justification for the credit note, supplementing the structured credit_reason_code. May reference specific time entries, disbursements, or billing guideline violations. Classified confidential as it may contain commercially sensitive negotiation details or LPP (Legal Professional Privilege) adjacent information.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Categorises the nature of the credit note by the component of the original invoice being reversed. 'fee_credit' — applies only to professional fees; 'disbursement_credit' — applies only to disbursements and expenses; 'tax_credit' — applies only to the tax component; 'combined' — spans multiple invoice components.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit note amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency billing environments and foreign exchange (FX) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System

attributes.name: disbursement_credit_amount
attributes.description: The amount of disbursements and client-chargeable expenses being credited on this credit note. Includes hard costs (court filing fees, expert witness fees) and soft costs (photocopying, courier). Expressed in the billing currency.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the formal billing dispute, client complaint, or ADR (Alternative Dispute Resolution) proceeding that gave rise to this credit note. Populated when credit_reason_code is 'dispute_resolution'. Classified confidential due to commercially sensitive negotiation context.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules Rule 1.5; SRA Code of Conduct; ADR Alternative Dispute Resolution frameworks

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the credit note amounts from the billing currency to the firm's functional (home) currency at the time of issuance. Required for multi-currency consolidation and financial reporting under IFRS/US GAAP.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fee_arrangement_type
attributes.description: The type of fee arrangement (AFA — Alternative Fee Arrangement) under which the original invoice was billed and against which this credit note is issued. Determines the financial impact on realization rate calculations and AFA performance tracking.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules Rule 1.5; UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System

attributes.name: fee_credit_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of professional fees being credited or reversed on this credit note, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the pre-tax fee reduction. Used in realization rate analysis and WIP (Work in Progress) reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; ABA Model Rules Rule 1.5

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The total credit note amount converted to the firm's functional (home) currency using the exchange_rate at issuance date. Used for consolidated financial reporting, GL (General Ledger) posting, and partner profit calculations (PPP/PEP).
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; IFRS 21; US GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL (General Ledger) account code to which the credit note is posted in the firm's accounting system. Required for financial close, trial balance reconciliation, and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) internal controls compliance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; US GAAP; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the credit note was formally issued and transmitted to the client. This is the principal business event date for the credit note lifecycle, used for AR ageing, period-end close, and tax reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; ABA Model Rules; HMRC VAT Notice 700

attributes.name: office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the firm office or branch responsible for the matter associated with this credit note. Used for office-level financial reporting, GL (General Ledger) cost centre allocation, and geographic revenue analysis.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing

attributes.name: originating_invoice_date
attributes.description: The issuance date of the original invoice being credited. Used to calculate the elapsed time between invoice issuance and credit note issuance for billing dispute analytics and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: originating_invoice_number
attributes.description: The human-readable invoice number of the original invoice being reversed or reduced by this credit note. Stored as a denormalised reference to support client-facing documents and LEDES electronic billing submissions without requiring a join.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; LEDES 1998B Standard

attributes.name: pro_bono_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit note relates to a pro bono matter (True) or a standard commercial matter (False). Required for pro bono reporting to the ABA (American Bar Association) and Law Society, and for exclusion from commercial realization rate calculations.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules Rule 6.1 (Voluntary Pro Bono Publico Service); Law Society of England and Wales Pro Bono Protocol

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this credit note record originated. 'elite_3e' — Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; 'aderant_expert' — Aderant Expert Time and Billing; 'manual' — manually entered outside a primary system. Required for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer data lineage standards

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: The tax component (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) being reversed or adjusted on this credit note. Must be reported separately for tax authority compliance and VAT/GST return reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; HMRC VAT Notice 700; IRS Publication 15; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO country or sub-national jurisdiction code identifying the tax authority under which the VAT, GST, or sales tax credit is calculated and reported. Required for multi-jurisdictional tax compliance and VAT/GST return reconciliation.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; HMRC VAT Notice 700; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IRS Publication 15; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate (as a percentage) used to calculate the tax_credit_amount on this credit note. Stored for audit trail purposes as tax rates may change over time.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; HMRC VAT Notice 700; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total gross value of the credit note inclusive of fees, disbursements, and tax adjustments (fee_credit_amount + disbursement_credit_amount + tax_credit_amount). This is the net amount by which the client's AR balance is reduced or refunded. Core field for AR reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; Aderant Expert Time and Billing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the credit note record was last modified in the billing system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: utbms_task_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Task-Based Management System (UTBMS) Task Code
attributes.description: The UTBMS (Uniform Task-Based Management System) task code associated with the primary fee component being credited. Used in task-based billing analysis and client billing guideline compliance reporting.
attributes.references: UTBMS Uniform Task-Based Management System; LEDES 1998B Standard; ABA Model Rules

attributes.name: voided_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit note was voided or cancelled. Populated only when credit_note_status is 'voided'. Required for audit trail and period-end reversal processing.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: write_off_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit note has been formally approved as a write-off (True) by the authorised partner or finance committee. Relevant when credit_reason_code is 'write_off'. Required for bad debt provisioning, GL (General Ledger) write-off posting, and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) internal controls.
attributes.references: Elite 3E Practice Management and Financial System; SOX Section 404; US GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

domains.name: conflict
domains.description: Manages new business intake, conflict-of-interest screening, ethical wall configuration, and clearance workflows required before any matter may be opened. Integrates Intapp Conflicts as the system of record. Enforces ABA Rule 1.7/1.9/1.10 conflict rules, lateral hire screening, and relationship mapping to protect LPP and firm ethics obligations.

products.name: check
products.description: Core transactional record of each conflict-of-interest screening request initiated during new business intake or lateral hire onboarding. Captures the check type (ABA Rule 1.7 current client, Rule 1.9 former client, Rule 1.10 imputed disqualification, lateral hire), the triggering event, requestor, assigned reviewer(s) and their roles, clearance status, and disposition. Reviewer assignments (primary reviewer, ethics partner, supervising partner) with their individual disposition recommendations are tracked directly on this record. This is the primary operational entity of the conflict domain and the system-of-record entry sourced from Intapp Conflicts.
products.reference: Intapp Conflicts — New Business Intake Check

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.assessment. Business justification: A conflict check triggers a formal risk assessment in legal practice. When a conflict is identified, the firm must assess severity and treatment options. Legal risk managers expect the check record to

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.outside_counsel_guideline. Legal ops teams cross-reference the applicable OCG during conflict review to confirm no prohibited

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Clearance workflow references applicable obligations to determine waiver requirements and eth

attributes.name: actual_turnaround_hours
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in hours from submission to final disposition, used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance monitoring and process improvement.

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the conflict check was assigned to the primary reviewer for analysis.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the conflict check request, typically displayed to users and referenced in communications.

attributes.name: check_type
attributes.description: Classification of the conflict check based on the triggering event and applicable American Bar Association (ABA) Model Rules of Professional Conduct. ABA Rule 1.7 addresses concurrent conflicts of interest with current clients, Rule 1.9 addresses conflicts with former clients, and Rule 1.10 addresses imputed disqualification within the firm.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct 1.7, 1.9, 1.10

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the conflict check indicating whether the matter or engagement has been cleared to proceed, rejected due to conflicts, or is pending further review.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the conflict check received final clearance approval, allowing the matter or engagement to proceed.

attributes.name: client_waiver_obtained

attributes.name: client_waiver_required

attributes.name: conflict_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified conflicts, including parties involved, nature of the conflict, and potential risks to Legal Professional Privilege (LPP) and firm ethics obligations.

attributes.name: conflict_severity

attributes.name: ethics_partner_disposition

attributes.name: ethics_partner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the ethics partner responsible for final review and approval authority.

attributes.name: mitigation_measures
attributes.description: Description of measures implemented to mitigate identified conflicts, such as ethical walls, client waivers, or engagement scope limitations.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this conflict check record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: primary_reviewer_disposition
attributes.description: Recommendation or decision rendered by the primary reviewer regarding clearance of the conflict check.

attributes.name: primary_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary reviewer assigned to conduct the conflict analysis.

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: rejected_timestamp

attributes.name: requestor_email

attributes.name: reviewer_notes

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp

attributes.name: supervising_partner_disposition

attributes.name: supervising_partner_name

attributes.name: triggering_event

attributes.name: waiver_obtained_date

products.name: conflict_party
products.description: Master registry of all parties — clients, adverse parties, related entities, individuals, and corporate affiliates — indexed in the conflict search universe. Each party record captures name variants, role classification (client, adverse, related entity, guarantor, beneficial owner), entity type (individual, corporation, government, trust, partnership), jurisdiction of incorporation or domicile, KYC/AML flags, and active/inactive status. Serves as the searchable party index used by every conflict check. Distinct from the client domains client record: this product owns the conflict-specific party classification and search indexing; a party here may or may not be a firm client. For multi-jurisdictional firms, party records are subject to data residency requirements — GDPR-regulated party data (EU/UK natural persons) must be stored and processed within compliant regions, with appropriate cross-border transfer mechanisms documented.

attributes.name: conflict_party_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the conflict party record. Primary key for the conflict party registry. This is the system-generated identifier used internally for conflict search indexing and relationship mapping.

attributes.name: aml_kyc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_kyc_program. Business justification: Conflict parties undergo AML/KYC screening under a specific program that determines risk methodology, documentation requirements, and screening scope. The party record must reference the governing AML

attributes.name: individual_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.individual. Business justification: Lateral hire screening and individual client intake conflict checks require linking conflict parties to individual client records. Business process: when candidates disclose prior matters or when scre

attributes.name: kyc_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.kyc_record. Business justification: Conflict analysis requires AML/KYC status of identified parties — regulators require firms to screen conflict parties for AML risk. conflict_party.kyc_status and aml_risk_rating are denormalized from

attributes.name: organisation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.organisation. Business justification: Conflict clearance workflow requires linking conflict parties to client organisations for adverse representation checks, corporate hierarchy conflict analysis, and relationship mapping. When screening

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.register. Business justification: A conflict party with elevated AML, sanctions, or PEP status generates a risk register entry for ongoing monitoring. Legal compliance teams track sanctioned or PEP-linked parties in the risk register

attributes.name: adverse_media_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse media (negative news coverage related to financial crime, corruption, fraud, or other reputational risk) has been identified for this party during due diligence. True indicates adverse media found, requiring risk assessment and potential escalation. False indicates no adverse media identified. Part of enhanced due diligence for high-risk parties.

attributes.name: ccpa_subject_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a consumer under CCPA (California resident). True indicates CCPA applies, requiring compliance with consumer rights (right to know, right to delete, right to opt-out of sale). False indicates CCPA does not apply. Used to enforce data governance policies for California-based parties.

attributes.name: conflict_search_indexed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party record has been indexed in the conflict search engine and is available for conflict checking. True indicates the party is searchable; false indicates indexing is pending or failed. Used to ensure data quality and completeness of the conflict search universe.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this party record was first created in the conflict system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_residency_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The jurisdiction in which this party's data must be stored and processed to comply with data protection regulations. For EU/UK natural persons, this must be an EU/UK region per GDPR Article 44-50 (cross-border data transfers). For parties in other jurisdictions, this reflects applicable data localization laws. Critical for multi-jurisdictional firms to ensure compliant data storage and processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-50 (Cross-Border Data Transfers), Data Localization Laws

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: The legal form of the party. Individual represents a natural person; corporation represents a for-profit incorporated entity; partnership represents a general or limited partnership; trust represents a fiduciary arrangement; government represents a public sector entity; nonprofit represents a tax-exempt organization; LLC (Limited Liability Company) represents a hybrid entity structure. Entity type affects KYC/AML requirements and conflict analysis scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|partnership|trust|government|nonprofit|llc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Legal Entity Classification Standard, KYC Best Practice

attributes.name: external_party_reference
attributes.description: An external reference identifier for this party, such as a client-provided reference number, a court case number, or a third-party system identifier. Used for cross-referencing with external systems and documents. Optional field for additional context.

attributes.name: gdpr_subject_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a data subject under GDPR (EU/UK natural person or entity operating in EU/UK). True indicates GDPR applies, requiring compliance with data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability) and cross-border transfer restrictions. False indicates GDPR does not apply. Used to enforce data governance policies and access controls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope), GDPR Article 15-22 (Data Subject Rights)

attributes.name: identifier_type
attributes.description: The type of official identifier associated with this party. Tax_id represents a tax identification number (EIN, SSN, VAT); company_registration represents a corporate registry number; passport represents a passport number; national_id represents a government-issued ID; duns_number represents a Dun & Bradstreet identifier; LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) represents an ISO 17442 identifier for financial entities. Used in conjunction with party_identifier_value for KYC/AML verification.

attributes.name: identifier_value
attributes.description: The actual identifier value corresponding to the party_identifier_type. For example, the EIN number, company registration number, passport number, or LEI code. This field is restricted due to PII sensitivity and is used for definitive party matching and KYC/AML verification. Must be encrypted at rest and subject to access controls per firm data governance policy.

attributes.name: industry_sector
attributes.description: The primary industry or business sector in which the party operates. Examples include financial services, healthcare, technology, energy, manufacturing, real estate, etc. Used for conflict analysis (industry-specific conflicts), business development segmentation, and risk assessment. May follow standard industry classification systems such as NAICS or SIC codes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_of_incorporation
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction where the entity is incorporated, registered, or domiciled. For corporations and LLCs, this is the state or country of incorporation. For individuals, this is the country of citizenship or primary residence. For trusts, this is the jurisdiction governing the trust instrument. Critical for determining applicable conflict rules, data residency requirements under GDPR, and regulatory compliance obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope), Corporate Law Standards

attributes.name: jurisdiction_of_primary_operations
attributes.description: The primary geographic jurisdiction where the party conducts business operations or resides. May differ from jurisdiction of incorporation for multinational entities. Used for conflict analysis when parties operate across multiple jurisdictions and for assessing cross-border data transfer requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which KYC verification was successfully completed for this party. Used to track KYC currency and trigger periodic re-verification per firm policy (typically annually or biennially). Null if KYC has not been completed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this party record was most recently modified. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: name_variant_1
attributes.description: First alternate name or alias for the party. Used to capture DBA (Doing Business As) names, trade names, former legal names, or common abbreviations. Critical for comprehensive conflict search coverage to ensure all name variations are indexed.

attributes.name: name_variant_2
attributes.description: Second alternate name or alias for the party. Captures additional name variations such as translated names, historical names, or subsidiary brand names to ensure thorough conflict screening.

attributes.name: name_variant_3
attributes.description: Third alternate name or alias for the party. Provides additional name variant coverage for complex entities with multiple operating names or jurisdictional variations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the party, such as special conflict considerations, relationship history, or due diligence findings. Confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information or attorney work product. Used by conflict analysts and intake teams for decision-making.

attributes.name: party_name
attributes.description: The primary legal name of the party as it appears in official records. For individuals, this is the full legal name; for organizations, this is the registered legal entity name. This is the primary searchable field in conflict checks and must match incorporation documents, government registrations, or identity documents.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 1.7 (Conflict of Interest), Intapp Conflicts Standard

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the party in the conflict system. Active indicates the party is current and searchable; inactive indicates the party is no longer active but retained for historical conflict checks; merged indicates the entity has been acquired or merged into another entity; dissolved indicates a legal entity has been formally dissolved; deceased indicates an individual has died. Inactive, merged, dissolved, and deceased parties remain in the conflict index for historical conflict analysis per ABA Rule 1.9 (former client conflicts).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 1.9 (Duties to Former Clients)

attributes.name: pep_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) — an individual who holds or has held a prominent public function (government official, senior executive of state-owned enterprise, etc.). True indicates PEP status, which triggers enhanced due diligence requirements under AML regulations. False indicates non-PEP status.

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: The version number of this party record, incremented with each modification. Used for optimistic locking and change tracking. Starts at 1 when the record is created.

attributes.name: role_classification
attributes.description: The role this party plays in conflict analysis. Client indicates a current or former client of the firm; adverse_party indicates an opposing party in litigation or transaction; related_entity indicates a corporate affiliate, subsidiary, or parent; guarantor indicates a party providing financial backing; beneficial_owner indicates the ultimate controlling individual; witness indicates a party who may provide testimony. This classification drives conflict rule application per ABA Model Rules 1.7, 1.9, and 1.10.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 1.7, ABA Model Rule 1.9, ABA Model Rule 1.10

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed for this party. Used to ensure screening currency and trigger periodic re-screening per firm policy. Null if screening has not been performed.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: The result of screening this party against global sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU, etc.). Not_screened indicates screening has not been performed; clear indicates no matches found; match_found indicates a potential hit requiring investigation; under_review indicates a match is being evaluated by compliance. Sanctions screening is mandatory before matter opening per AML regulations.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Programs, EU Sanctions Lists, UN Security Council Sanctions

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record from which this party record originated. Intapp_conflicts indicates the party was created in the conflict system; elite_3e indicates the party was imported from the practice management system; crm indicates the party was imported from the CRM system; manual_entry indicates the party was manually created by a user; lateral_hire_screening indicates the party was added during lateral attorney conflict screening. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_party_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this party in the source system (e.g., the client ID in Elite 3E, the account ID in CRM). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking. Null if the party was created directly in the conflict system.

attributes.name: ultimate_beneficial_owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) — the natural person(s) who ultimately own or control the entity, typically defined as owning 25% or more of the entity or exercising control through other means. Required for KYC/AML compliance and for identifying individual-level conflicts when representing corporate entities. Restricted due to PII sensitivity.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 24 (Beneficial Ownership), AML Compliance Standards

products.name: search_execution
products.description: Transactional record of each individual name or entity search executed within a conflict check. Captures the search string, phonetic and fuzzy-match variants applied, search algorithm version, number of hits returned, and the timestamp of execution. One conflict_check may spawn multiple search_execution records (one per party searched). Sourced from Intapp Conflicts search audit log. Note: the logical primary key is conflict_search_id; the physical PK conflict_conflict_search_id reflects the platform naming convention (domain prefix + product-derived name).

attributes.description: Primary key for search_execution
