attributes.name: primary_check_id
attributes.description: FK to conflict.conflict_check.conflict_check_id — Each search execution belongs to exactly one conflict check. This is the header-to-line relationship that enables reconstructing the full search scope of a check.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Search executions are mandated by specific regulatory obligations (e.g., SRA Code of Conduct requiring conflict checks before engagement). Regulatory audit trails require each search execution to dire

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.request. Business justification: Conflict search executions are directly triggered by intake requests. Direct FK enables SLA reporting and audit traceability — 'which intake request spawned this search execution' — without requiring

attributes.name: to_check_id
attributes.description: FK to conflict.conflict_check.conflict_check_id — Every search execution is spawned by a specific conflict check — this is the core parent-child relationship in the screening workflow. Without this FK, you cannot reconstruct which searches belong to

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or exception message if the search execution failed or timed out. Null for successful executions. Used for troubleshooting and system monitoring.

attributes.name: ethical_wall_consideration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this search execution considered existing ethical walls (information barriers) in the conflict analysis. When true, conflicts may be waivable if an effective ethical wall can be established per ABA Rule 1.10.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 1.10 - Imputation of Conflicts; Ethical Screens

attributes.name: exact_match_count
attributes.description: The number of hits that were exact string matches (case-insensitive). Subset of total hit_count. Exact matches typically require immediate escalation.

attributes.name: fuzzy_match_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether fuzzy matching algorithms were applied to capture approximate string matches, accounting for typos, abbreviations, and minor variations.

attributes.name: fuzzy_match_count
attributes.description: The number of hits that were fuzzy matches (approximate string similarity). Subset of total hit_count. Requires review to determine relevance.

attributes.name: fuzzy_match_threshold
attributes.description: The similarity threshold percentage (0-100) used for fuzzy matching. Higher values require closer matches. Typically set between 70-90% depending on firm policy.

attributes.name: hit_count
attributes.description: The total number of potential conflict matches returned by this search execution. A hit count of zero indicates no conflicts found; non-zero requires human review.

attributes.name: include_former_names_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search included historical names and aliases (e.g., maiden names, previous corporate names, DBA names). Essential for comprehensive conflict detection.

attributes.name: include_subsidiaries_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the search included subsidiary and affiliate entities of the searched organization. Critical for corporate family conflict detection.

attributes.name: industry_filter
attributes.description: Optional industry sector filter applied to narrow the search scope to specific client industries (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Technology). May contain comma-separated industry codes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_filter
attributes.description: Optional geographic or legal jurisdiction filter applied to narrow the search scope. May contain comma-separated jurisdiction codes (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU) or state/province codes.

attributes.name: lateral_hire_screen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this search was executed as part of a lateral hire screening process. Lateral hire searches require broader scope to identify conflicts the incoming attorney may bring from their previous firm.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rule 1.10 - Lateral Hire Conflict Screening

attributes.name: phonetic_match_count
attributes.description: The number of hits that were phonetic matches (sound-alike names). Subset of total hit_count. Requires review to determine if they represent the same entity.

attributes.name: phonetic_variant_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether phonetic matching algorithms (e.g., Soundex, Metaphone) were applied to capture names that sound similar but are spelled differently.

attributes.name: practice_area_filter
attributes.description: Optional practice area filter applied to narrow the search scope to specific legal practice areas (e.g., M&A, IP, Litigation). May contain comma-separated practice area codes.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this search execution record was first created in the conflict system. Typically identical or very close to search_execution_timestamp.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this search execution record was last modified. Updates may occur if search results are re-analyzed or if additional metadata is appended.

attributes.name: relationship_depth
attributes.description: The number of relationship hops traversed during the search. Depth of 1 searches direct relationships; depth of 2+ searches related entities (e.g., subsidiaries, affiliates, beneficial owners). Higher depth increases search comprehensiveness but also processing time.

attributes.name: search_algorithm_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the conflict search algorithm used for this execution. Enables audit trail and reproducibility when algorithms are updated or tuned.

attributes.name: search_duration_milliseconds
attributes.description: The elapsed time in milliseconds from search initiation to result return. Used for performance monitoring and system optimization.

attributes.name: search_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this search was executed in the conflict system. Critical for audit trail and establishing the temporal context of conflict clearance.

attributes.name: search_result_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the search result set. Enables detection of result changes if the same search is re-executed later, supporting audit and change tracking.

attributes.name: search_scope
attributes.description: Defines the population of records searched. Determines whether the search covers only current clients, includes former clients (for ABA Rule 1.9 successive representation conflicts), adverse parties, or all parties in the system.

attributes.name: search_status
attributes.description: The outcome status of the search execution. Completed indicates successful execution; failed/timeout/cancelled indicate technical issues requiring retry or escalation.

attributes.name: search_string
attributes.description: The exact name or entity string submitted for conflict search. This is the raw input text used to query the conflict database for potential matches.

attributes.name: search_type
attributes.description: The category of entity being searched. Determines which conflict rules and matching algorithms are applied.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this search execution record in the source system (Intapp Conflicts). Used for data lineage and reconciliation between the lakehouse and the operational system.

products.name: search_hit
products.description: Each potential conflict match surfaced by a conflict search against the party index and matter history. Records the matched party, the matter or engagement where the relationship was found, the relationship type (current client, former client, adverse party, related entity), the match confidence score, and the reviewing attorneys initial assessment (potential conflict, no conflict, waivable). Central to the conflict clearance workflow. Note: the logical primary key is conflict_hit_id; the physical PK conflict_conflict_hit_id reflects the platform naming convention.

attributes.name: search_hit_id
attributes.description: Primary key for search_hit

attributes.name: assessment_id

attributes.name: matched_patent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ip.patent. Business justification: Patent conflict reporting requires direct access to patent-specific data (prosecution_status, patent_type, claims count) not available on ip_asset. When a conflict search hits a patent, attorneys need

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Conflict hits are triaged and assessed based on practice area to determine severity and route to specialized reviewers. Practice area context drives conflict severity scoring and determines which ethi

attributes.description: Reference to the party record that matched the search criteria. Links to the intake_party product.

attributes.name: primary_search_execution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent conflict search that generated this hit. Links to the conflict_search product.

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.register. Business justification: A high-severity or unresolved conflict search hit is a risk event that must be logged in the risk register. Legal risk managers expect search hits above a severity threshold to generate risk register

attributes.name: to_conflict_party_id
attributes.description: FK to conflict.party.party_id — Each search hit references the matched party record from the conflict party index. Critical for resolving what entity was matched.

attributes.name: to_search_execution_id
attributes.description: FK to conflict.search_execution.search_execution_id — Each hit is produced by a specific search execution. This is the fundamental lineage link from hit back to the search that produced it.

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the reviewing attorney explaining the rationale for the initial assessment. Critical for audit trail and ethics compliance.

attributes.name: conflict_severity
attributes.description: System-assigned severity level based on relationship type, matter status, and match confidence. High severity requires partner-level review.

attributes.name: escalated_to_partner

attributes.name: ethical_wall_required

attributes.name: hit_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this hit within the parent conflict search results. Used for display and review prioritization.

attributes.name: hit_source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the source record in the originating system. Used for drill-back and data reconciliation.

attributes.name: hit_source_system
attributes.description: The system or database that provided the data for this conflict hit. Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: initial_assessment
attributes.description: The reviewing attorneys initial assessment of the conflict hit. Drives the clearance workflow and escalation path.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.7, 1.9

attributes.name: is_false_positive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this conflict hit has been determined to be a false positive (e.g., name collision, unrelated entity). Used for machine learning model training.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this conflict hit record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lpp_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this conflict hit presents a risk to Legal Professional Privilege (attorney-client privilege). High-risk hits require senior partner review.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct Rule 1.6

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: Algorithmic confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the likelihood that the matched party is the same entity as the search subject. Based on name similarity, identifier matching, and relationship graph analysis.

attributes.name: match_method
attributes.description: The matching technique that surfaced this hit (exact name match, fuzzy name match, identifier match, corporate family relationship, etc.). Used for quality assessment and false-positive filtering. attributes.name: matched_client_name
attributes.description: The name of the client on the historical matter where the conflict was found. Critical for assessing current vs. former client conflicts under ABA Rule 1.9.

attributes.name: matched_matter_description
attributes.description: Brief description of the historical matter where the conflict was identified. Provides context for conflict reviewers.

attributes.name: matched_party_name
attributes.description: The name of the party as recorded in the historical matter or party index. Denormalized for display and review efficiency.

attributes.name: matter_close_date
attributes.description: The date the historical matter was closed. Null if the matter is still active. Used to distinguish current vs. former client conflicts.

attributes.name: matter_open_date
attributes.description: The date the historical matter was opened. Used to determine recency and relevance of the conflict.

attributes.name: matter_status
attributes.description: Current status of the historical matter where the conflict was identified. Active matters present higher conflict risk.

attributes.name: relationship_role
attributes.description: Specific role the matched party played in the historical matter (e.g., plaintiff, defendant, guarantor, shareholder). Provides context for conflict assessment.

attributes.name: relationship_type

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp

attributes.name: responsible_attorney_name

attributes.name: review_timestamp

attributes.name: reviewed_by_attorney_name

attributes.name: substantially_related_matter

attributes.name: waiver_date

attributes.name: waiver_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal conflict waiver has been obtained from the affected client(s). Required before matter opening can proceed.

products.name: clearance
products.description: Formal clearance decision record issued at the conclusion of a conflict check workflow. Captures the clearance outcome (cleared, cleared with conditions, declined — conflict identified, deferred pending waiver), the authorizing partner or general counsel, the ABA rule basis for any identified conflict, and the date clearance was granted or denied. When conditions are imposed (e.g., mandatory ethical wall erection, restricted matter scope, required client notification, periodic review), each condition is recorded with its type, responsible party, due date, and fulfillment status directly on this record. This record gates matter opening in Elite 3E.

attributes.name: clearance_id

attributes.name: adverse_party_identified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an adverse party (opposing party in litigation or transaction) has been identified that creates a conflict with an existing client. True if adverse party conflict exists; False otherwise.

attributes.name: clearance_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the clearance decision, typically formatted as CLR-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in correspondence and audit trails.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clearance decision. Pending Review: awaiting partner review; Cleared: no conflict, matter may open; Cleared with Conditions: approved subject to ethical wall or other restrictions; Declined - Conflict Identified: conflict exists and cannot be waived; Deferred Pending Waiver: conflict exists but client waiver is being sought; Withdrawn: intake request was withdrawn before clearance completed.

attributes.name: client_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the client must be formally notified of the conflict and provide informed consent as a condition of clearance. True if client notification and consent are required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7, 1.9; Informed Consent Requirements

attributes.name: client_waiver_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether informed written consent (waiver) has been obtained from all affected clients. True if all required waivers are on file; False if waivers are pending or not obtained.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.7, 1.9; Informed Consent Requirements

attributes.name: condition_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which all clearance conditions must be fulfilled before the matter may proceed. Null if no conditions or no specific due date.

attributes.name: condition_fulfilled_date
attributes.description: The date on which all clearance conditions were confirmed as fulfilled and the matter was authorized to proceed. Null if conditions are not yet fulfilled.

attributes.name: condition_fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Overall status of compliance with all imposed clearance conditions. Not Applicable: no conditions imposed; Pending: conditions not yet started; In Progress: conditions being implemented; Fulfilled: all conditions satisfied; Overdue: one or more conditions past due date.

attributes.name: conditions_imposed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the clearance was granted subject to conditions (ethical wall, scope restriction, client notification, periodic review). True if conditions exist; False if unconditional clearance or denial.

attributes.name: conflict_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified conflict, including the nature of the adverse interest, the relationship between parties, and the factual basis for the conflict determination. Confidential business information protected by Legal Professional Privilege (LPP).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.6, 1.7; Legal Professional Privilege

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clearance record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date the authorizing partner or general counsel issued the final clearance decision (cleared, declined, or deferred). This date gates matter opening in Elite 3E.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; Elite 3E Matter Management

attributes.name: deferral_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the clearance decision was deferred, including what additional information or client waiver is required before a final decision can be made. Empty if clearance was not deferred.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.7

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the clearance was denied, including the specific conflict identified, the parties involved, and the ethical rule violated. Empty if clearance was approved. Confidential business information protected by Legal Professional Privilege (LPP).
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.6, 1.7, 1.9; Legal Professional Privilege

attributes.name: ethical_wall_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an ethical wall (information barrier) must be erected as a condition of clearance. True if ethical wall is mandatory; False otherwise. Ethical walls prevent information flow between conflicted timekeepers and the matter team.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.10; Intapp Conflicts Ethical Wall Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the clearance decision expires and must be re-evaluated. Typically set for time-sensitive matters or when circumstances may change. Null if clearance does not expire.

attributes.name: imputed_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the conflict is imputed to the entire firm under ABA Rule 1.10 (conflicts of interest imputed to all lawyers in the firm). True if conflict is firm-wide; False if conflict is limited to specific timekeepers.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules 1.10; Intapp Conflicts System

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this clearance record was last updated. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: lateral_hire_screening_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this clearance is part of a lateral hire conflict screening process (evaluating conflicts that a new attorney would bring to the firm). True if lateral hire screening; False for standard new matter clearance.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.9, 1.10

attributes.name: matter_opened_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the matter has been formally opened in Elite 3E following clearance approval. True if matter is open; False if clearance granted but matter not yet opened or clearance was denied.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of the clearance decision. Null if no periodic review is required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special instructions related to the clearance decision. May include guidance for the matter team, reminders for periodic review, or references to related clearances. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final decision outcome of the clearance process. Approved: no conflict, unconditional clearance; Approved with Conditions: clearance granted subject to ethical wall, scope restriction, or client notification; Denied: conflict identified and matter cannot proceed; Deferred: decision postponed pending additional information or waiver.
attributes.references: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct

attributes.name: periodic_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the clearance decision requires periodic re-evaluation (e.g., quarterly review of ongoing conflict status). True if periodic review is mandated; False for one-time clearance.
attributes.references: Intapp Conflicts System; ABA Model Rules 1.7

attributes.name: legal_service_id

attributes.name: predecessor_ownership_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership rights were assigned or transferred to the current owner. Represents the effective date of the assignment agreement.
attributes.references: Patent Assignment Standards, Trademark Assignment Guidelines

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Legal basis or mechanism by which ownership was acquired. Distinguishes between original application, assignment, merger/acquisition, inheritance, court order, license conversion, or other mechanisms. attributes.references: Patent Assignment Standards, Corporate Transaction Guidelines

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficial owner (e.g., tax ID, national ID, passport number). Required for KYC and AML compliance.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF), AML Regulations

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate beneficial owner if different from the legal owner. Required for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Client (KYC) compliance.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF), AML Regulations

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Monetary consideration paid for the assignment or transfer of ownership rights. May be zero for assignments without monetary consideration (e.g., employment agreements).
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, M&A Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: consideration_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the consideration amount. Required when consideration_amount is non-zero.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which this ownership record is effective. Null for current ownership. Supports temporal tracking of ownership changes and chain of title reconstruction.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ownership record is effective. Supports temporal tracking of ownership changes and chain of title reconstruction.

attributes.name: frand_commitment_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Commitment Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the FRAND commitment or declaration made to the relevant standards development organization (SDO).
attributes.references: FRAND Guidelines, Standards Development Organization (SDO) Policies

attributes.name: frand_obligation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Obligation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) licensing obligations, typically for standard-essential patents.
attributes.references: FRAND Guidelines, Standards Development Organization (SDO) Policies

attributes.name: is_current_owner
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this record represents the current owner of the IP asset. True for the active ownership record, false for historical records.

attributes.name: joint_ownership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to joint ownership by multiple parties. True if multiple ownership records exist for the same IP asset.
attributes.references: Joint Ownership Guidelines, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the jurisdiction in which this ownership record applies. IP ownership may vary by jurisdiction for international assets.

attributes.name: license_back_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment includes a license-back provision allowing the assignor to continue using the IP. Common in employment and M&A contexts.
attributes.references: Patent Licensing Standards, M&A Due Diligence Guidelines

attributes.name: license_back_terms
attributes.description: Summary of the license-back terms if applicable, including scope, duration, and any royalty obligations.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this ownership record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ownership record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes over time.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the ownership record. May include special conditions, restrictions, or contextual information relevant to the ownership.

attributes.name: of_asset
attributes.description: FK to ip.asset.asset_id — Ownership records establish chain of title for specific IP assets. Essential for assignment tracking and M&A due diligence.

attributes.name: owner_address
attributes.description: Full legal address of the owner entity as recorded with the IP office. Required for official correspondence and recordal purposes.

attributes.name: owner_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for correspondence with the owner regarding this IP ownership record.

attributes.name: owner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the owner regarding this IP ownership record.

attributes.name: owner_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country of domicile or incorporation of the owner entity.

attributes.name: owner_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the entity or individual that holds ownership rights in the IP asset. May be an individual inventor, corporate assignee, joint owner, or government entity.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership entity type. Distinguishes between individual inventors, corporate assignees, joint owners, government entities, universities, and trusts.

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership record. Tracks whether ownership is active, pending recordal, transferred to another party, terminated, under dispute, or lapsed.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership interest held by this owner in the IP asset. For sole ownership, this is 100.00. For joint ownership, reflects the proportional share.

attributes.name: recordal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership assignment was officially recorded with the relevant IP office or registry. Critical for establishing priority and chain of title.
attributes.references: USPTO Assignment Recordation, EPO Recordal Guidelines

attributes.name: recordal_number
attributes.description: Official recordal or registration number issued by the IP office when the ownership assignment was recorded. Used for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: security_interest_description
attributes.description: Description of any security interest, lien, or encumbrance affecting the IP ownership. Includes details of the secured party and nature of the security.
attributes.references: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), Security Interest Guidelines

attributes.name: security_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP asset is subject to a security interest, lien, or encumbrance that affects ownership rights. True if security interest exists.
attributes.references: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC), Security Interest Guidelines

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ownership record was last verified or validated. Critical for due diligence and portfolio audits.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the ownership verification process. Indicates whether the chain of title has been verified, is pending verification, remains unverified, or is disputed.
attributes.references: IP Due Diligence Standards, M&A Guidelines

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that performed the ownership verification. Used for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this ownership record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: inventor
products.description: Master record for individual inventors named on patent applications and grants, maintaining independent lifecycle for inventorship determination, derivation proceedings, and assignment chain management. Captures inventor full name, nationality, residence address, employer at time of invention, invention disclosure date, assignment executed flag, oath or declaration status, inventor contribution description, joint inventor flag, and employment agreement reference. Supports inventorship disputes, correction of inventorship filings, assignment chain integrity verification, and derivation proceeding risk management. Linked to patents via many-to-many relationship reflecting that inventors may appear on multiple patent applications.

attributes.name: inventor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventor record. Primary key for the inventor entity.

attributes.name: patent_id
attributes.description: FK to ip.patent.patent_id — Inventors are named on specific patent applications. This many-to-many relationship is essential for inventorship determination and assignment chain integrity.

attributes.name: assignment_executed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventor has executed a formal assignment of patent rights to the employer or assignee. Critical for chain of title verification.

attributes.name: assignment_execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor signed the patent assignment document transferring rights to the assignee.

attributes.name: assignment_recordation_number
attributes.description: USPTO or patent office recordation number for the assignment document. Used to verify chain of title in patent prosecution and litigation.
attributes.references: 37 CFR 3.11 (Recording of Assignment); USPTO Assignment Database

attributes.name: conception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor conceived the complete and operative invention. Used for priority determination in interference and derivation proceedings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 102 (Conditions for Patentability); Hybritech Inc. v. Monoclonal Antibodies, Inc.

attributes.name: contribution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the inventor's specific contribution to the conception of the claimed invention. Used for inventorship determination and correction of inventorship proceedings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 116 (Inventors); Pannu v. Iolab Corp. (inventorship standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventor record was first created in the IP management system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the inventor record originated (e.g., patent docketing system, invention disclosure system, HR system).

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: Date of death of the inventor, if applicable. Triggers substitute statement requirements for pending applications.

attributes.name: derivation_proceeding_number
attributes.description: USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) proceeding number for any derivation proceeding involving this inventor.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for inventor correspondence regarding patent prosecution, inventorship disputes, and assignment execution.

attributes.name: employer_at_invention
attributes.description: Name of the organization employing the inventor at the time the invention was conceived. Critical for determining assignment rights and work-for-hire status.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 261 (Ownership and Assignment); Employment Agreement IP Clauses

attributes.name: employment_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the employment agreement containing IP assignment provisions. Used to verify pre-invention assignment obligations.

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Last or family name of the inventor. Used for structured name parsing in international patent filings.

attributes.name: full_legal_name
attributes.description: Complete legal name of the inventor as it appears on patent applications and grants. Used for inventorship determination and official USPTO/EPO/WIPO filings.
attributes.references: 35 U.S.C. § 115 (Inventor's Oath or Declaration); PCT Rule 4.5

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: First or given name of the inventor. Used for structured name parsing in international patent filings.

attributes.name: invention_disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor formally disclosed the invention to the employer or patent counsel. Establishes priority date for derivation proceedings and assignment chain.

attributes.name: inventor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventor record. Affects ability to obtain signatures for continuation applications and assignment documents.

attributes.name: inventorship_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventor is involved in an inventorship dispute, derivation proceeding, or correction of inventorship petition.

attributes.name: joint_inventor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventor is one of multiple joint inventors on one or more patent applications. Joint inventors must each contribute to the conception of at least one claim.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventor record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: legal_representative_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal representative (executor, administrator, guardian) authorized to act on behalf of a deceased or incapacitated inventor.

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the inventor's nationality. Required for PCT applications and determines eligibility for certain patent prosecution highways.

attributes.name: oath_declaration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the inventor executed the oath or declaration for the patent application.

attributes.name: oath_declaration_status
attributes.description: Status of the inventor's oath or declaration required for patent application filing. Indicates whether the inventor has sworn to the accuracy of the application.

attributes.name: orcid_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: ORCID (Open Researcher and Contributor ID) Identifier
attributes.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for the inventor as a researcher. Facilitates disambiguation of inventor names across patent offices and academic publications.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the inventor. Used for urgent patent prosecution matters and inventorship verification.

attributes.name: prior_art_disclosure_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventor has an ongoing duty to disclose known prior art material to patentability under the duty of candor.
attributes.references: 37 CFR 1.56 (Duty to Disclose Information Material to Patentability)

attributes.name: residence_address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the inventor's residence. Required for inventor oath or declaration filings.

attributes.name: residence_address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line of the inventor's residence (apartment, suite, building number).

attributes.name: residence_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the inventor's residence address.

attributes.name: residence_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the inventor's country of residence at time of invention. Determines applicable patent law jurisdiction and filing requirements.

attributes.name: residence_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the inventor's residence address.

attributes.name: residence_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the inventor's residence address.

products.name: patent_family
products.description: Master record grouping related patent applications and grants that share a common priority claim into a patent family. Captures family identifier, priority application reference (earliest filing), priority date, family type (simple/Paris Convention, extended/INPADOC, complete), member jurisdiction count, technology area (IPC/CPC based), strategic importance rating, family status, and continuation/divisional chain indicators. Enables portfolio-level analysis, freedom-to-operate assessments, patent landscape mapping, and coordinated multi-jurisdictional prosecution strategy.

attributes.name: patent_family_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patent family record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intake.engagement_opportunity. Business justification: Patent family prosecution strategy is initiated through an engagement opportunity. Firms track which BD opportunity led to a multi-jurisdiction patent family prosecution engagement for origination cre

attributes.description: Reference to the legal matter under which this patent family is managed. Links to the matter master data product for billing, timekeeper assignment, and matter-level reporting.
attributes.references: LEDES Legal Electronic Data Exchange Standard, ABA Matter Management Standards

attributes.name: practice_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.practice_area. Business justification: Patent families are managed at portfolio level under specific practice areas (e.g., patent prosecution, SEP licensing). Practice area classification drives staffing allocation, partner assignment, and

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client entity that owns or controls this patent family. Links to the client master data product.

attributes.name: register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.register. Business justification: Patent family portfolio risk management requires a family-level risk register entry for aggregate litigation, invalidity, and FRAND exposure tracking. Individual patents have register_id but the famil

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Patent families with frand_obligation_indicator or standard_essential_patent_indicator are governed by specific regulatory obligations (e.g., ETSI IPR Policy, competition law FRAND commitments). SEP p

attributes.name: abstract_text
attributes.description: Brief technical summary of the invention from the priority or representative application. Typically 150-300 words describing the technical problem, solution, and key features.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements, USPTO MPEP 608.01(b)

attributes.name: active_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family record is currently active in the system. True for active records, False for archived or soft-deleted records. Used for data retention and reporting filters.

attributes.name: annuity_payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of annuity (maintenance fee) payments across all family members. Current (all fees paid), Overdue (payment missed but within grace period), Grace_period (in statutory grace period), Lapsed (patent rights lost due to non-payment).
attributes.references: EPC Rule 51 Renewal Fees, USPTO 37 CFR 1.362 Maintenance Fees

attributes.name: continuation_chain_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes continuation, continuation-in-part, or divisional applications. True if continuation chain exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO MPEP Chapter 200 - Types and Status of Application, 35 USC 120

attributes.name: cpc_class
attributes.description: Primary CPC classification code. Joint classification system developed by EPO and USPTO providing more granular technical categorization than IPC.
attributes.references: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) Scheme, EPO/USPTO Joint Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent family record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, GDPR Article 5 Data Accuracy

attributes.name: divisional_chain_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes divisional applications filed to pursue distinct inventions disclosed in a parent application. True if divisional chain exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPC Article 76 Divisional Applications, USPTO MPEP 201.06

attributes.name: docketing_system_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier in the IP docketing system (e.g., CPI, Foundation IP, Alt Legal) used for deadline management and prosecution tracking. Enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: family_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the patent family, typically assigned by the IP management system or patent office. Used for cross-system reference and client communication.

attributes.name: family_status
attributes.description: Current overall status of the patent family. Active (at least one granted and in-force patent), Pending (applications under prosecution), Expired (all patents reached end of term), Abandoned (all applications withdrawn or rejected), Lapsed (all patents lapsed due to non-payment).
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Register Standards, USPTO Patent Status Definitions

attributes.name: family_type
attributes.description: Classification of the patent family structure. Simple (Paris Convention family sharing same priority), Extended (INPADOC family including all related applications), Complete (all documents sharing technical content).
attributes.references: INPADOC Family Classification Standards, EPO Patent Family Definitions

attributes.name: frand_obligation_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Reasonable and Non-Discriminatory (FRAND) Obligation Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family is subject to FRAND (Fair, Reasonable, and Non-Discriminatory) licensing obligations due to standard-essential patent (SEP) declarations. True if FRAND-encumbered, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ETSI IPR Policy, IEEE Patent Policy, ISO/IEC Patent Policy

attributes.name: freedom_to_operate_status
attributes.description: Status of freedom-to-operate analysis for this patent family. Clear (no blocking patents identified), Risk_identified (potential infringement risk found), Under_review (FTO analysis in progress), Not_assessed (no FTO performed). Business-confidential strategic information.
attributes.references: ABA IP Section FTO Best Practices

attributes.name: invention_title
attributes.description: The title of the invention as disclosed in the priority or representative application. Used for quick identification and portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements

attributes.name: inventor_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of inventor names as disclosed in the priority application. May be business-confidential depending on client agreement and jurisdiction disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: WIPO Standard ST.12 Bibliographic Data Elements, 35 USC 115

attributes.name: ipc_class
attributes.description: Primary IPC classification code assigned to this patent family. Hierarchical classification system used worldwide for categorizing patent documents by technical field.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this patent family record was last updated. Critical for change tracking, audit compliance, and data synchronization.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, GDPR Article 5 Data Accuracy

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Current licensing posture of this patent family. Unlicensed (no active licenses), Exclusively_licensed (single licensee with exclusive rights), Non_exclusively_licensed (multiple licensees), Cross_licensed (licensed as part of cross-license agreement).
attributes.references: WIPO Licensing Guide for Universities, ABA IP Licensing Standards

attributes.name: litigation_involvement_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family is currently or has been involved in patent litigation, opposition, or inter partes review proceedings. True if litigation history exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO PTAB Proceedings, EPO Opposition Proceedings

attributes.name: member_jurisdiction_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct jurisdictions (countries or patent offices) where patent applications or grants exist as members of this family. Indicates geographic breadth of protection.
attributes.references: WIPO Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Statistics Standards

attributes.name: next_annuity_due_date
attributes.description: Earliest upcoming annuity or maintenance fee due date across all active family members. Critical for IP docketing and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: EPC Rule 51 Renewal Fees, USPTO 37 CFR 1.362 Maintenance Fees

attributes.name: opposition_count
attributes.description: Total number of opposition or post-grant review proceedings filed against patents in this family. Indicator of competitive interest and patent strength.
attributes.references: EPC Article 99 Opposition, USPTO AIA Post-Grant Review

attributes.name: pct_application_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family includes a PCT international application. True if PCT route was used, False otherwise. Critical for understanding prosecution strategy and timeline.

attributes.name: portfolio_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of this patent family based on valuation methodology (cost, market, income approach). Used for portfolio management, licensing negotiations, and financial reporting. Business-confidential.
attributes.references: ISO 10668 Brand Valuation, AICPA Valuation Standards

attributes.name: pph_eligibility_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this family is eligible for accelerated examination under Patent Prosecution Highway agreements based on allowance in a participating office. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: USPTO Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) Program, IP5 PPH Guidelines

attributes.name: priority_application_number
attributes.description: The application number of the earliest filing (priority application) that establishes the priority date for this patent family. Format typically includes country code and serial number.
attributes.references: Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property Article 4, WIPO Standard ST.13

attributes.name: priority_country_code
attributes.description: ISO country code of the jurisdiction where the priority application was filed. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, WIPO Standard ST.3

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: The earliest filing date claimed by any member of this patent family. Critical for determining patent term, prior art cutoff, and prosecution strategy across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: Paris Convention Article 4, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) Article 8

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this patent family record originated (e.g., Elite 3E, IP docketing system, patent office data feed). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Data Management Standards, DAMA-DMBOK Data Lineage

attributes.name: standard_essential_patent_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this patent family has been declared as essential to one or more technical standards. True if declared as SEP, False otherwise.
attributes.references: ETSI IPR Database, IEEE SA Standards Board Bylaws

attributes.name: strategic_importance_rating
attributes.description: Business assessment of the strategic value of this patent family to the client's IP portfolio. Used for prioritization of prosecution spend, licensing strategy, and portfolio pruning decisions.

attributes.name: technology_area
attributes.description: Primary technology domain or field of invention based on International Patent Classification (IPC) or Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) codes. Used for portfolio segmentation and landscape analysis.
attributes.references: WIPO International Patent Classification (IPC), Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC)

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the portfolio valuation amount.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the portfolio valuation was performed or last updated. Critical for financial reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 10668 Brand Valuation, AICPA Valuation Standards

attributes.description: File path or URI to the folder in the document management system (DMS) where all documents related to this copyright are stored. Links to iManage Work or NetDocuments.

attributes.name: duration_years
attributes.description: The calculated duration of copyright protection in years from the date of creation or publication. Varies by jurisdiction and work type.

attributes.name: enforcement_action_count
attributes.description: The total number of enforcement actions (cease and desist letters, litigation, takedown notices) taken to protect this copyright. Used for portfolio risk assessment.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the copyright protection expires and the work enters the public domain. Calculated based on copyright duration rules.

attributes.description: FK to ip.asset.asset_id — Copyright registration is a subtype extension of ip_asset. Must reference parent asset for portfolio management.

attributes.name: fair_use_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fair use analysis has been conducted for this work in relation to potential infringement claims. Relevant for enforcement strategy.

attributes.name: infringement_detected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any copyright infringement has been detected for this work. True if infringement monitoring has identified unauthorized use.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The country or jurisdiction code where the copyright is registered or claimed. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes for standardization.

attributes.name: licensing_status
attributes.description: Current licensing status of the copyright. Indicates whether the work is available for licensing and under what terms.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this copyright record was last modified or updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the copyright registration and management. Used for attorney work product and internal communications.

attributes.name: office_name
attributes.description: The name of the copyright office or registration authority where the copyright is registered (e.g., U.S. Copyright Office, UK Intellectual Property Office).

attributes.name: portfolio_category
attributes.description: Business classification or grouping of the copyright within the clients IP portfolio. Used for strategic portfolio management and reporting.

attributes.name: preexisting_work_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the preexisting work(s) upon which this derivative work is based. Includes title, author, and registration information of the underlying work.
attributes.references: U.S. Copyright Office Circular 14 - Derivative Works

attributes.name: registration_certificate_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or file path to the official copyright registration certificate issued by the copyright office. Links to the document management system (DMS).

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the copyright registration was officially granted by the copyright office. Establishes the effective date of registration for enforcement purposes.
attributes.references: 17 U.S.C. § 410 - Registration of Claim and Issuance of Certificate

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The official registration number assigned by the copyright office upon successful registration. Unique identifier for the registered copyright.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the copyright registration with the relevant copyright office. Indicates whether the work has formal registration protection.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: The estimated monetary value of the copyright asset. Used for portfolio valuation, financial reporting, and transaction purposes.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency in which the valuation amount is expressed. Uses ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the copyright valuation was performed or last updated. Critical for financial reporting and portfolio management.

attributes.name: work_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the copyrighted work including its nature, content, and distinguishing characteristics. Used for identification and enforcement purposes.

attributes.name: work_made_for_hire_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work was created as a work made for hire, affecting copyright ownership and duration. True if the work was created by an employee within the scope of employment or under a written agreement.

attributes.name: work_title
attributes.description: The title or name of the copyrighted work as registered or claimed. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the work.

attributes.name: work_type
attributes.description: The category or type of copyrighted work. Classifies the work according to copyright law categories for registration and enforcement purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: literary|musical|dramatic|artistic|audiovisual|software|architectural|sound_recording|choreographic|pictorial_graphic_sculptural|compilation|derivative — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: year_of_creation
attributes.description: The year in which the work was created or fixed in tangible form. Critical for determining copyright duration and term calculations.

attributes.name: year_of_first_publication
attributes.description: The year in which the work was first published or made available to the public. Affects copyright duration and registration requirements.

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Governs the full Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) pipeline for both client-facing engagement letters (LOE, POA, SPA, NDA) and firm vendor/supplier agreements. Distinct from the matter domain — contract owns the agreement artifact; matter owns the work performed under it.

products.name: obligation
products.description: Granular obligation register extracted from executed agreements, capturing each discrete contractual duty, covenant, representation, warranty, or condition precedent as a header record with associated lifecycle event lines. Header stores obligation text, category (payment, delivery, reporting, confidentiality, regulatory, IP assignment), responsible party, due date, recurrence schedule, priority, and fulfillment status. Line-level event records capture the full audit trail: creation, fulfillment, partial completion, breach notice, cure, waiver, and escalation events with actor, timestamp, event type, supporting document reference, and resulting status change. SSOT for all obligation data including lifecycle events. Core to CLM obligation tracking, dispute resolution evidence, and regulatory compliance reporting.

products.name: template_clause_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the deliberate composition relationship between a contract template and a clause from the approved clause library. It captures the operational act of a knowledge management or CLM team assigning a specific clause to a specific template, including whether the clause is mandatory in that template context, its structural position, and whether negotiators may override it. Each record links one template to one clause_library entry with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific template-clause pairing.. Existence Justification: In legal contract lifecycle management, templates are explicitly assembled from a curated library of approved clauses — a template contains many clauses, and a clause is reused across many templates. This is a core operational process actively managed by knowledge management and CLM teams: they assign specific clauses to templates, configure whether each clause is mandatory or optional in that template context, set its position/order, and control override permissions. The relationship is a recognized business concept in CLM systems (iManage, Ironclad, Conga all model this as an explicit junction entity called 'template clause assignment' or similar).

attributes.name: template_clause_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Template Clause Assignment - Template Clause Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the template_clause_assignment association

attributes.name: clause_library_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Template Clause Assignment - Clause Library Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the clause library entry assigned to this template.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the contract template that contains this clause assignment.

attributes.name: clause_position
attributes.description: Structural placement descriptor for the clause within the template (e.g., 'Section 4', 'Schedule 2', 'Recital C'). Provides human-readable positional context beyond numeric sort order.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this clause-template pairing became active and operative. Supports versioning of template composition over time — a clause may be added to or removed from a template at a specific date.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this clause is mandatory within this specific template. A clause may be mandatory in one template (e.g., confidentiality in an NDA) but optional in another (e.g., confidentiality in an MSA). Cannot live on either parent entity alone.

attributes.name: override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether negotiators are permitted to deviate from or modify this clause when using this template. Override permissions may differ per template — a clause may be locked in a high-risk template but negotiable in a standard commercial template.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of this clause within the template structure. Determines the order in which clauses appear in the assembled document. Meaningless without the template context.

attributes.name: template_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this clause is integrated into automated contract templates within the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or Document Management System (DMS) for automated document assembly. [Moved from clause_library: This boolean on clause_library indicates whether a clause is integrated into automated templates, but this is a derived/aggregate property. The ground truth is captured at the assignment level — if any active template_clause_assignment record exists for a clause, it is template-integrated. The flag on clause_library becomes redundant and potentially stale once the association table exists. Consider deprecating it in favour of a computed view over the association table.]

products.name: ledger_entry
products.description: Granular double-entry ledger record for every debit and credit movement within a client trust account. The single source of truth (SSOT) for all trust fund transactions — no other product in this domain records financial movements. Covers all transaction types including: receipts (advance retainers, settlement proceeds, escrow deposits, court-ordered funds) with source-of-funds, payment method, client authorization reference, and AML screening attributes; disbursements (third-party payments, fee transfers to operating, settlement distributions, filing fees, expert witness payments) with payee, disbursement category (UTBMS cost code), signatory attorney, and authorization status; transfers between accounts; interest credits; and bank charge reversals. Captures transaction date, value date, transaction type, direction (debit/credit), amount, running balance, matter reference, counterparty identity, payment method (wire, cheque, ACH, SWIFT), authorization reference, and LEDES coding where applicable. Receipt entries include source-of-funds classification and AML screening outcome. Disbursement entries link to disbursement_authorization for approval workflow. The atomic unit of trust accounting — every three-way reconciliation, client balance, and regulatory report is built from these entries.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The bank account number for the trust account being reconciled. Masked or encrypted in reporting; full number required for audit trail.

attributes.name: bank_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified on the bank statement (incorrect charges, duplicate transactions, posting errors). Requires bank correction and documentation.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution holding the trust account (e.g., JPMorgan Chase, HSBC). Required for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: bank_statement_balance
attributes.description: The ending balance reported on the bank statement for the trust account as of the reconciliation period end date. First leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The statement date printed on the bank statement used for this reconciliation. Typically matches reconciliation_period_end_date but may differ for mid-month reconciliations.

attributes.name: book_balance
attributes.description: The trust ledger balance per the firm's accounting system (Elite 3E GL trust account) as of the reconciliation period end date. Second leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: client_ledger_total
attributes.description: The sum of all individual client sub-ledger balances as of the reconciliation period end date. Third leg of the three-way reconciliation. Must equal book_balance when no variances exist.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Trust accounts are typically single-currency.

attributes.name: deposits_in_transit_total
attributes.description: Total amount of deposits recorded in the trust ledger but not yet reflected on the bank statement as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: The number of reconciling items (outstanding checks, deposits in transit, errors) identified during this reconciliation. Zero indicates clean reconciliation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction governing this trust account (e.g., USA state code, GBR for England and Wales). Trust accounting rules vary by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this reconciliation record was last updated. Tracks changes during the reconciliation lifecycle (in_progress to completed).

attributes.name: ledger_errors_total
attributes.description: Total amount of errors identified in the firm's trust ledger (posting errors, incorrect amounts, duplicate entries). Requires correcting journal entries and audit trail.

attributes.name: outstanding_checks_total
attributes.description: Total amount of checks issued from the trust account that have not yet cleared the bank as of the reconciliation date. Reconciling item between book and bank balances.

attributes.name: prior_period_unresolved_variance
attributes.description: The unresolved variance amount carried forward from the previous reconciliation period. Should be resolved in current period or escalated.

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the reconciliation: manual (spreadsheet-based), semi_automated (system-assisted with manual review), fully_automated (system-generated with exception-only review).

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the reconciliation record, typically formatted as RECON-YYYYMM-NNNN for monthly reconciliations.

attributes.name: reconciliation_performed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reconciliation work was completed by the preparer. Must be within regulatory timeframes (typically within 30 days of period end).

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the period covered by this reconciliation, typically the last day of the month. Mandatory monthly reconciliation under most jurisdictions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the period covered by this reconciliation, typically the first day of the month.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation process: in_progress (reconciliation being performed), completed (reconciliation finished with no exceptions), exception (variances identified requiring resolution), under_review (submitted for partner review), approved (final sign-off completed).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this reconciliation was submitted to the regulatory authority, if required. Null if no filing is required or filing is pending.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation must be submitted to the regulatory authority (e.g., annual IOLTA report, SRA accountant's report). True if filing is required.

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reviewer completed their review of the reconciliation. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: timing_differences_total
attributes.description: Total amount of legitimate timing differences between book and bank that will self-resolve in subsequent periods (e.g., end-of-month transactions posted next business day).

attributes.name: total_variance_amount
attributes.description: The net difference between the three reconciliation legs. Calculated as (bank_statement_balance + outstanding_items) - book_balance. Zero indicates perfect reconciliation.

attributes.name: unresolved_exception_count
attributes.description: The number of reconciling items that remain unresolved as of the current date. Non-zero values require follow-up and escalation.

attributes.name: unresolved_variance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of variance that remains unexplained after all reconciling items have been identified and documented. Non-zero values require escalation and investigation.

attributes.name: variance_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explaining identified variances, root cause analysis, corrective actions taken, and resolution status. Required for regulatory examination audit trail.

products.name: bank_statement
products.description: Imported or manually entered bank statement record for each trust account covering a defined statement period, including header-level summary and all constituent line items. Header captures financial institution name, account number, statement period start and end dates, opening balance, closing balance, total credits, total debits, statement source (electronic feed, PDF import, manual entry), and import timestamp. Line items (modeled as detail records within this product) capture transaction date, posting date, description, debit amount, credit amount, running bank balance, transaction reference number, and matching status to a trust_ledger_entry. Enables automated matching during reconciliation and identification of unmatched bank transactions requiring investigation. Serves as the external reference leg of the three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank statement record. Primary key for the bank statement entity.

attributes.name: primary_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trust account for which this statement was issued. Links to the trust account master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: bank_statement has iolta_reporting_period and reconciliation_status but no FK to the regulatory obligation. IOLTA and regulatory reporting requires bank statements to be traceable to the obligation ma

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to trust.trust_account.trust_account_id — Each bank statement belongs to a specific trust account. Required for the external leg of three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: average_daily_balance
attributes.description: The average daily balance for the trust account during the statement period as calculated by the financial institution. Used for interest calculation verification.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: The branch or office code of the financial institution where the trust account is held. May be used for multi-branch reconciliation.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the end of the statement period as reported by the financial institution. This is the external reference balance for three-way reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement. Typically USD for US-based IOLTA accounts.

attributes.name: discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: The net difference between the bank statement closing balance and the trust ledger balance at the end of the statement period. Zero indicates a balanced reconciliation.

attributes.name: financial_institution_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the bank or financial institution that issued this statement.

attributes.name: import_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement was imported or entered into the trust accounting system.

attributes.name: interest_earned
attributes.description: The total interest earned on the trust account during this statement period. Critical for IOLTA reporting and remittance to state bar foundations.

attributes.name: iolta_reporting_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Lawyers Trust Accounts (IOLTA) Reporting Period
attributes.description: The IOLTA reporting period identifier (e.g., Q1-2024, 2024-01) to which this statement belongs. Used for regulatory reporting aggregation.

attributes.name: is_final_statement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final statement for a closed trust account. Used for account closure workflows and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The two-letter state or jurisdiction code where this trust account is registered and regulated. Critical for jurisdiction-specific IOLTA compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank statement record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the beginning of the statement period as reported by the financial institution.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this bank statement was successfully reconciled and approved. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the three-way reconciliation process for this bank statement. Tracks whether the statement has been matched against trust ledger and client balances.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit ABA routing number for the financial institution. Used for electronic funds transfer and account identification.

attributes.name: service_charges
attributes.description: The total bank fees and service charges deducted during the statement period. Must be tracked separately for IOLTA compliance.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The official statement date as printed on the bank statement by the financial institution. Typically the same as the statement period end date.

attributes.name: statement_file_hash
attributes.description: The cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the original statement file. Ensures document integrity and detects tampering for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: statement_file_path
attributes.description: The storage location or document management system path where the original bank statement file is archived. Used for audit retrieval.

attributes.name: statement_format
attributes.description: The file format or data standard of the original statement document. Used for parsing and validation logic.

attributes.name: statement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this bank statement. May include reconciliation notes, exception explanations, or special instructions.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: The unique statement number or reference assigned by the financial institution for this statement period.

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date covered by this bank statement period.

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date covered by this bank statement period.

attributes.name: statement_source
attributes.description: The method by which this bank statement was imported or entered into the system. Indicates data provenance for audit purposes.

attributes.name: total_credit_count
attributes.description: The number of credit transactions posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_credits
attributes.description: The sum of all credit transactions (deposits, interest, reversals) posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debit_count
attributes.description: The number of debit transactions posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debits
attributes.description: The sum of all debit transactions (withdrawals, fees, disbursements) posted during the statement period.

attributes.name: unmatched_transaction_count
attributes.description: The number of bank statement line items that have not been matched to a corresponding trust ledger entry. Used to identify reconciliation exceptions.

Ensures complete audit trail for all inter-account fund movements.
